Bir D/G seti; sabit devirde çalışan bir: A diesel generator set consists of a diesel engine running at constant speed and a synchronous alternator coupled to it. Because the frequency (50/60 Hz) depends on the engine speed, the governor keeps the speed constant. The alternator produces its magnetic field through excitation; the output voltage is held constant by the AVR.
AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulator), yük d: The AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulator) keeps the terminal voltage constant by adjusting the alternator excitation as the load changes. Reactive load sharing (in parallel operation) is managed through the AVR droop setting; a faulty AVR causes over- or under-voltage and load sharing problems.
Bir jeneratörü çalışan şebekeye almak (p: To connect a generator to a live switchboard (paralleling), four conditions must be met: the same voltage, the same frequency, the same phase sequence and the phases in step. The synchroscope and the check-synchronising relay verify these conditions; wrong paralleling causes a large current surge and damage.
Paralel jeneratörlerde aktif yük (kW) go: With generators in parallel, the active load (kW) is shared through the governors and the reactive load (kVAr) through the AVRs. Unbalanced sharing overloads one set. A modern PMS (Power Management System) manages load sharing, automatic start/stop and the connection of the standby set.
Şebeke aşırı yüklenince blackout'u önlem: When the switchboard is overloaded, preferential tripping disconnects non-essential loads (HVAC, heaters and so on) in a predefined order to prevent a blackout. Generator protection includes reverse power, overcurrent, under/over-voltage and frequency relays.
Tüm jeneratörler durursa blackout oluşur: If all generators stop, a blackout occurs; the ship is left dark and without propulsion. The emergency generator starts automatically and supplies the essential safety loads. A black start means starting a main generator using emergency power and compressed air and re-establishing the switchboard.
Bakım; motor tarafında supap/enjektör/ya: Maintenance covers valves, injectors, oil and filters on the engine side, and insulation resistance (megger), bearings and brushes/diodes (if fitted) on the alternator side. Regular test runs and protection relay tests are carried out.
Fire-tube (alev borulu) kazanda sıcak ga: In a fire-tube boiler the hot gases pass through the tubes and the water is in the shell; it is simple and works at low pressure. In a water-tube boiler the water passes through the tubes and the gases are outside; it gives high pressure and fast steam raising. On many motor ships a composite boiler is heated both by fuel and by the exhaust gas.
Besleme suyu (feed water), besleme pompa: Feed water is pumped into the boiler by the feed pump and turns into steam with heat; after use it returns as condensate to the cascade/hotwell tank and is fed again. Steam traps separate the condensate from the steam. The water level is monitored with the gauge glass and a level sensor.
Oil-fired kazanda brülör (burner) yakıtı: In an oil-fired boiler the burner atomises the fuel, a fan supplies the air and firing is switched on and off according to the steam pressure (on/off or modulating). The air/fuel ratio is optimised for efficiency and emissions; too little air causes soot and smoke, too much air causes a loss of efficiency.
Kazan en kritik emniyet sistemlerinden b: The boiler is one of the most critical safety systems. Low-low water level cut-out, flame failure protection, high pressure protection and safety valves are mandatory. Low water can cause the tubes to overheat and burst.
Kazan suyu; korozyon, kireç (scale) ve k: Boiler water is treated to prevent corrosion, scale and carryover (foaming). pH/alkalinity, chloride, phosphate and dissolved oxygen are tested regularly and controlled by chemical dosing and blow-down. Hardness and oxygen corrosion directly affect the life of the tubes.
Exhaust gas economizer, ana makine egzoz: The exhaust gas economiser turns the main engine's exhaust heat into steam; at low load, accumulated soot and oil can ignite (soot fire / iron fire). Regular soot blowing, water washing and low-load warnings reduce this risk. A high exhaust outlet temperature can be an early sign.
Bakım; brülör temizliği, gauge glass pur: Maintenance covers burner cleaning, gauge glass blow-through, safety valve testing, cleaning of the water side and the gas side, checking the refractory (firebrick) and soot blowing/water washing of the EGE. The safety valve set pressure is verified regularly.
Separatör, yüksek devirde dönen bowl (ka: A separator spins the liquid in a bowl rotating at high speed; because of the difference in density, the heavy phase (water, solids) collects at the outside and the light phase (clean fuel or oil) towards the centre. The disc stack enlarges the separating surface and speeds up settling. Sludge is discharged periodically or automatically.
Purifier modunda su fazı vardır ve su sü: In purifier mode there is a water phase and water is discharged continuously; the water/fuel interface is set with the gravity disc. In clarifier mode there is no water and only solids are separated; as there is no water outlet, a blind disc is used instead of a gravity disc. A purifier followed by a clarifier in series gives the best cleaning.
Purifier'da gravity disc (dam ring) çapı: In a purifier, the diameter of the gravity disc (dam ring) is chosen for the density and temperature of the fuel; a wrong disc upsets the water/fuel interface (fuel escapes with the water, or water with the fuel). The maker's nomogram and the fuel density and temperature are used to choose correctly.
Modern separatörler self-cleaning (otoma: Modern separators work with self-cleaning (automatic bowl discharge) and water content monitoring (water transducer); without a gravity disc, the water discharge is controlled by the sensor. This reduces the need for manual adjustment over a wide density range.
Cat fines (alüminyum-silikon katalizör k: Cat fines (aluminium-silicon catalyst residues) are hard, abrasive particles in HFO; they rapidly wear liners, piston rings and fuel injection equipment. ISO 8217 sets an Al+Si limit for bunkers, but the value at the engine inlet must be much lower. Separator efficiency is the main way of reducing cat fines.
Bakım; bowl/disc seti sökme-temizleme, c: Maintenance covers dismantling and cleaning the bowl and disc stack, renewing seals (O-rings), checking the gearbox and friction clutch, testing the water seal and monitoring vibration. Regular cleaning maintains the separation efficiency.
Marş havası genelde ~30 bar gerektirir;: Starting air generally requires about 30 bar; compressing in a single stage causes overheating and a loss of efficiency. Two-stage compression is therefore used: the first stage raises the air to an intermediate pressure, the intercooler cools it and the second stage brings it to the final pressure. Cooling increases efficiency and reduces carbonisation of the oil.
Sıkışan hava nem ve yağ buharı içerir; a: Compressed air contains moisture and oil vapour; the aftercooler and moisture separator remove the water, and an air dryer also removes moisture from the control air. Wet or oily air clogs instrument valves and creates a risk of explosion in the starting air line; drains are opened regularly.
Hava şişesinden gelen yüksek basınçlı ha: High-pressure air from the air receiver goes through the main starting valve and the air distributor to the cylinder starting valves; it is admitted to the cylinders in the correct order and turns the engine. Wrong timing or a leaking starting valve can cause a blowback or an explosion.
Marş hattında flame arrester (alev tutuc: The starting air line has a flame arrester, and each receiver has a safety valve and a bursting disc. Air receivers are subject to class survey; internal corrosion and thickness are checked.
Klas, reversible ana makineler için hava: For reversible main engines, class requires the air receivers to provide a certain number (typically 12) of consecutive starts without being recharged. There are usually two independent compressors and two air receivers; if one fails, the other maintains the starting capability.
Bakım; supap (suction/discharge) temizli: Maintenance covers cleaning the suction and discharge valves, wear of piston rings and liners, cleaning the intercooler and aftercooler, safety valve testing and checking the automatic drains and the unloader. The air receivers are inspected internally and drained regularly.
Santrifüj (dinamik) pompalar, çark (impe: Centrifugal (dynamic) pumps give the liquid velocity with an impeller and convert it into pressure; they are ideal for high flow, low to medium pressure and low viscosity (seawater, ballast, fire). Positive displacement (PD) pumps move a fixed volume per revolution; they suit high viscosity and high pressure (fuel, oil, hydraulics).
Santrifüj pompanın debisi (Q) arttıkça b: As the flow (Q) of a centrifugal pump increases, its head (H) falls (the H-Q curve). The operating point is where the pump curve crosses the system resistance curve. Throttling a valve increases the system resistance and reduces the flow; if the pump runs against a closed valve (shut-off), it heats up.
Pompa emişindeki mevcut net pozitif emme: If the net positive suction head available at the pump suction (NPSHa) falls below the value the pump requires (NPSHr), the liquid vaporises and cavitation occurs; this causes impeller erosion, noise, vibration and loss of flow. The risk rises with hot or volatile liquids, a blocked strainer or a high suction lift.
PD pompa kapalı vanaya karşı çalışırsa b: If a PD pump runs against a closed valve, it raises the pressure without limit and bursts the line or the pump. A relief (safety/bypass) valve is therefore mandatory in every PD pump line. Unlike a centrifugal pump, a PD pump is never throttled against a closed discharge.
Santrifüj pompa kendiliğinden emiş yapam: A centrifugal pump cannot prime itself; it needs priming (filling with water) or a self-priming device. Pumps connected in parallel increase the flow; connected in series they increase the head. Standby pumps can cut in automatically.
Bakım; mekanik salmastra (mechanical sea: Maintenance covers mechanical seals or gland packing, impeller wear rings, bearings and lubrication, alignment and vibration, and cleaning of strainers. A leaking mechanical seal is dealt with early.
Atmosfer basıncında su 100 °C'de kaynar;: At atmospheric pressure water boils at 100 °C, but the main engine jacket water is only about 70–90 °C. The FWG creates a vacuum inside it (with an ejector) that lowers the boiling point to about 40–60 °C, so that seawater can be evaporated with low-grade waste heat. The vapour is condensed into fresh water and the salt is left behind.
Modern FWG'ler plakalı (plate) ısı eşanj: Modern FWGs use plate heat exchangers: one plate pack heats and evaporates the seawater with jacket water (the evaporator), the other condenses the vapour with seawater (the condenser). They are compact, efficient and easy to clean.
Ters ozmoz, deniz suyunu yüksek basınçla: Reverse osmosis forces seawater at high pressure (50–70 bar) through a semi-permeable membrane; the water passes and the salt ions are held back. It needs no heat source, runs on electricity and gives a high capacity at low temperature. Pre-filtration (sand/cartridge) and membrane chemistry are the critical maintenance issues.
Üretilen suyun tuzluluğu salinometre ile: The salinity of the water produced is measured continuously by the salinometer; if the salt content exceeds a set limit (typically about 10 ppm), a solenoid dump valve diverts the water overboard or to waste instead of to the tank. In this way salty or poor water does not get into the fresh water tank.
Liman, haliç ve kıyıya yakın kirli/sığ s: The FWG must not be run in ports, estuaries or polluted shallow waters near the coast; these waters contain bacterial and chemical pollution (bilge water, sewage). Production takes place at sea, in clean water. Drinking water also goes through UV treatment or chlorination and, if necessary, remineralisation.
Evaporatörde periyodik kireç sökme (acid: On the evaporator, periodic descaling (acid cleaning), plate cleaning, ejector performance and vacuum tightness are checked. On the RO plant, the pre-filters are changed, the membranes are flushed (CIP) and the HP pump is maintained.
Plakalı tip, ince oluklu (chevron desenl: The plate type consists of thin corrugated (chevron pattern) stainless steel or titanium plates clamped together with gaskets. The hot and cold fluids flow in opposite directions through adjacent channels; the corrugations create turbulence and increase heat transfer. It gives a very large transfer surface in a compact volume, and the plates can be taken apart for mechanical or chemical cleaning.
Bir akışkan boru demetinin içinden (tube: One fluid flows inside the tube bundle (tube side) and the other through the shell between the tubes (shell side); baffles direct the flow on the shell side. It withstands high pressure and temperature, is robust and tolerates fouling. It is preferred for fuel oil heaters, steam heaters and some large condensers.
Turboşarj sonrası sıkışan (ve ısınan) em: The intake air compressed (and heated) by the turbocharger is cooled in a cooler with a finned tube bundle. Cool air is denser; more oxygen enters the cylinder, so power and combustion efficiency increase. The water side is supplied with seawater or LT fresh water.
Transfer edilen ısı; toplam ısı transfer: The heat transferred depends on the overall heat transfer coefficient (U), the surface area (A) and the logarithmic mean temperature difference (ΔTlm). ΔTlm is the logarithmic mean of the temperature differences between the two fluids at the inlet and outlet, and it is highest in a counter-flow arrangement. Heat exchangers are therefore designed for counter-flow wherever possible.
Yüzeyde biriken tortu, biyofilm, kireç v: Deposits, biofilm, scale or an oil layer on the surface create an additional thermal resistance (fouling factor); U falls and less heat is transferred with the same area. Signs: the outlet temperature of the cooled fluid rises and the pressure difference (ΔP) increases. Performance is monitored by comparison with the reference values in the clean condition.
Merkezi soğutmada deniz suyu (SW) yalnız: In central cooling, seawater (SW) goes only to the central cooler and returns overboard from there. The machinery is cooled by fresh water (FW) circuits with low salinity and inhibitor. The high-temperature (HT) circuit cools the main engine jackets; the low-temperature (LT) circuit cools the L.O. cooler, the charge air cooler and the auxiliaries. A thermostatic three-way valve keeps the temperature constant.
Deniz suyu korozyonu ve deniz canlısı ki: Seawater corrosion and marine growth fouling are confined to the central cooler and a short SW line. Because the internal FW circuit stays clean and controlled, the machinery coolers last longer, maintenance intervals are extended and temperature control is more stable.
İç tatlı su devresine korozyon inhibitör: A corrosion inhibitor (typically nitrite-based) is dosed into the internal fresh water circuit and tested periodically; if the level falls, corrosion starts on the internal surfaces. On the seawater side, contact between different metals (steel, bronze, titanium) produces galvanic corrosion; sacrificial anodes and a suitable choice of materials are therefore used.
SW tarafı en hızlı kirlenen bölümdür. St: The SW side is the part that fouls fastest. The strainers are cleaned regularly; the plates or tubes are descaled periodically with chemicals (acid) and brushed mechanically. Chlorination (MGPS — marine growth prevention system) suppresses marine growth.
Giriş/çıkış sıcaklık ve ΔP değerleri düz: Inlet and outlet temperatures and ΔP values are recorded regularly; a deviation from the reference shows fouling. When a plate cooler is opened, the order and orientation of the plates are marked, and the gaskets are checked and renewed if necessary. The seawater strainer is cleaned often, and the plates or tubes are cleaned chemically at planned intervals.
Basınçlı sistemde flanş/cıvata gevşetmed: In a pressurised system, the equipment is isolated and the pressure released before any flange or bolt is slackened. Suitable PPE is used for chemical (acid) cleaning, and the work is followed by neutralisation and thorough rinsing. The condition of the anodes and coating on the seawater side is checked regularly.
Geleneksel tankerlerde pompa dairesinde: Conventional tankers have centrifugal cargo pumps in a pump room, driven by a shaft from the engine room or by a steam turbine. On modern product and chemical tankers each tank has its own deepwell or hydraulically driven (e.g. Framo) pump in the tank bottom; segregation and efficiency are better and the pump room is eliminated.
Booster pompa, uzun hat veya yüksek term: A booster pump is added in series with the main pump to maintain the flow with long lines or high back pressure from the terminal. A stripping pump takes the last liquid from the tank bottom (the low level that the centrifugal pump cannot take); it is usually a positive displacement pump or an eductor.
Kargo manifoldu, gemi hatlarının termina: The cargo manifold is the central point where the ship's lines are connected to the terminal's loading arms or hoses. With multi-grade cargoes, each parcel must be carried with its own set of pumps, lines and valves (segregation); commingling is not acceptable. The valve arrangement and the line diagram are settled before the operation.
Santrifüj kargo pompası, tank seviyesi d: As the tank level falls, a centrifugal cargo pump cavitates because of insufficient suction (low NPSH); with volatile cargoes, gas can also collect in the pump (gas binding/vapour lock) and cut off the flow. The rate is then reduced, stripping mode is used or the pump is primed again.
Acil durdurma (ESD — Emergency Shutdown): The emergency shutdown (ESD) system works in step with the terminal and, in danger, stops pumps and valves in a safe sequence. Pumping against a closed valve overpressurises the line; the valve sequence and pressure monitoring are therefore critical. Gas detection and ventilation of the pump room are mandatory.
Bakım; mekanik salmastra ve sızdırmazlık: Maintenance covers mechanical seals and sealing (cofferdam monitoring), bearings, the hydraulic system oil and pressure (Framo), manifold valves and wear rings. Pump room gas detectors and the bilge alarm are tested regularly.
Ham petrol kendi tortusunu çözen bir çöz: Crude oil is a solvent for its own deposits; the heavy residue sticking to the tank walls (clingage) is dissolved by jets of crude oil under pressure and discharged with the cargo. This produces much less waste (slops) than water washing and lets more cargo reach the terminal (higher outturn).
Tanklara sabit, programlanabilir yıkama: Fixed, programmable tank cleaning machines are installed in the tanks; rotating jets sweep the tank surfaces at different angles. Washing is supplied by the cargo pump pressure and the washing oil is removed by stripping.
COW yalnızca tank atmosferi inert (≤%8 O: COW may only be done while the tank atmosphere is inert (O₂ ≤ 8%); otherwise the static electricity created by the crude oil jets and the hydrocarbon vapour can cause an explosion. The IGS must run continuously, O₂ must be monitored and washing must be stopped if the limit is exceeded.
Yıkama aşamalı yapılır: boşaltmanın başı: Washing is done in stages: a top wash at the start of discharge while the upper parts are exposed, and a bottom wash as the level falls and the tank bottom is exposed. The machines are programmed to cover all surfaces (including shadow areas); after washing the bottom is cleaned by stripping.
MARPOL, yıkama sonrası tankın yeterince: MARPOL requires the tank to be sufficiently dry after washing; the bottom is drained with the help of trim and the last liquid is removed by stripping. This reduces the amount of slops and the contamination of later ballast water.
Bakım; yıkama makinesi dişli/nozul kontr: Maintenance covers checking the gears and nozzles of the washing machines, pressure testing the lines, calibrating the O₂ analyser and checking the drain lines. It is verified periodically that the machines sweep all surfaces.
Sounding, tank dibinden sıvı yüzeyine ol: Sounding is the distance from the tank bottom to the liquid surface; ullage is the space from the top of the tank (the reference point) to the liquid surface. In tanker operations the ullage is usually measured and converted to volume with the tank calibration table; with the temperature correction the standard volume (m³/bbl) is obtained.
UTI cihazı tek ölçümde ullage, sıcaklık: A UTI gives the ullage, temperature and oil/water interface in one measurement; the volume is corrected for temperature and the free water under the cargo is found. An accurate temperature is the basis of the commercial volume calculation (custody transfer).
Petrol/kimyasal tankerlerde tank atmosfe: On oil and chemical tankers, gauging without opening the tank atmosphere (closed gauging) is mandatory; otherwise gas is released and there is a risk of a flammable atmosphere. Fixed (radar/float) systems provide closed gauging; the UTI provides restricted gauging through a vapour lock valve.
Yükleme sırasında taşmayı önlemek için b: To prevent overflow during loading there are independent high-level and high-high-level alarms; the high-high level is usually linked to automatic closing or the ESD. These alarms must work with sensors independent of the main level system, so that a single failure cannot lead to an overflow.
Bakım; radar/float verici kalibrasyonu,: Maintenance covers calibration of the radar and float transmitters, alarm function tests, checking the UTI tape and sensor, and the tightness of the vapour lock valves. Automatic and manual readings are compared regularly.
Dökme yük gemilerinde side-rolling (yana: On bulk carriers, side-rolling covers give a wide hatch opening and full clearance for grabs and cargo handling. On container ships, pontoon (lift-away) covers are lifted off by crane and containers are stowed on top of them. Folding covers are common on general cargo ships.
Su geçirmezlik, coaming üzerindeki compr: Weathertightness is achieved by the compression bar on the coaming pressing continuously and evenly into the rubber packing around the cover (set-down). Cleats and quick-acting cleats press the panel down onto the coaming. The set-down mark must be continuous; crushed or oily packing leaks.
Conta kanalında biriken su, drenaj kanal: Water collecting in the packing channel is drained overboard through a drain channel and a non-return valve. If the non-return valve is blocked or fitted the wrong way round, water gets into the hold. Coaming integrity and corrosion control are the basis of tightness.
Hortum testi (kapalı kapağa basınçlı su): The hose test (water under pressure on the closed cover) is the classic method; with cargo on board, the ultrasonic test (a transmitter inside, a receiver scanning outside) is preferred. The test finds leak points along the line of the packing.
Bakım; conta esneklik/değişim, compressi: Maintenance covers the elasticity and renewal of the packing, straightness of the compression bars, cleaning of the drain non-return valves, cleat adjustment, wheels and rails, and the hydraulics. Packing that has taken a permanent set is renewed.
Yelpaze gibi yalpalama (roll), baş-kıç v: Rolling, pitching and heaving create inertia forces on the cargo; the most critical transverse force comes from rolling. The lashing gear must withstand these forces and prevent the cargo from shifting or tipping. The force grows with acceleration × mass.
Her lashing elemanının MSL'i (Maximum Se: Every lashing element has an MSL (Maximum Securing Load); the working load is limited by a safety factor. The ship's approved Cargo Securing Manual (CSM) defines which gear is to be used and how, the stowage arrangement and the calculation; securing must follow the CSM.
Kötü hava beklentisinde rota/hız ayarı (: When bad weather is expected, course and speed are adjusted (weather routing), lashings are checked additionally and excessive rolling is avoided. An excessive GM (a stiff ship) causes violent, rapid rolling that strains the lashings; a very low GM gives a dangerous rolling period. Lashings are checked periodically throughout the voyage.
Ro-ro gemilerinde araç/trailer'lar güver: On Ro-Ro ships, vehicles and trailers are secured to the deck lashing points with web slings or chains and tensioners; wheel chocks are added. The lashing angle and number are chosen for the vehicle weight in accordance with the CSM.
Lashing donanımı; çatlak, deformasyon, k: Lashing gear is inspected regularly for cracks, deformation, corrosion and wear. Twistlock function, turnbuckle threads and the straightness of lashing rods are checked. A damaged item is taken out of service at once.
Reefer ünitesi standart soğutma çevrimiy: A reefer unit works on the standard refrigeration cycle: the compressor compresses the refrigerant gas, the (air-cooled) condenser rejects the heat outside, the expansion valve lowers the pressure and the evaporator draws heat from inside the container to cool the cargo. The set temperature (e.g. −18 °C frozen, +2 °C chilled) is maintained by a microcontroller.
Taze meyve/sebze solunum yapar (CO₂/etil: Fresh fruit and vegetables respire (producing CO₂ and ethylene); the fresh air vent setting controls these gases. In controlled atmosphere (CA) reefers the O₂/CO₂ ratio is actively managed to slow down ripening. These settings follow the carrying instructions for the cargo.
Gemi, reefer alanlarında standart 440V/3: The ship provides standard 440 V three-phase sockets (reefer plugs) in the reefer areas. The total number of reefers determines the ship's reefer power capacity (kVA), and the generator load is planned accordingly. The sockets must be water- and corrosion-resistant, earthed and protected by circuit breakers.
Reefer'lar düzenli olarak fiziksel veya: Reefers are monitored regularly, physically or remotely; the set temperature, actual temperature, alarms and power supply status are recorded (reefer monitoring). Before loading, the PTI (Pre-Trip Inspection) confirms that the unit is sound. The temperature record is evidence in cargo claims.
Reefer soketleri ıslak güverte ortamında: Reefer sockets work in a wet deck environment; earthing, insulation monitoring and circuit breaker protection are essential. Plugs must be connected with the power off; damaged cables or sockets must not be used.
Gemi tarafında bakım; soket/kablo bütünl: Maintenance on the ship's side covers the integrity of sockets and cables, testing of circuit breakers and earthing, the monitoring system and the power distribution boards. Maintenance of the refrigeration inside the unit is usually done by a shore service; on board, faults are diagnosed and recorded.
Ro-ro gemilerinde stern ramp/door (kıç),: Ro-Ro ships have a stern ramp/door aft, a bow visor and bow ramp forward, side ramps and internal ramps or lifts. The ramps serve both as the cargo route and, when closed, as a watertight barrier. They are usually moved by hydraulic cylinders or winches.
Kapı/rampa kapandıktan sonra çok sayıda: After the door or ramp is closed, a large number of hydraulic or mechanical locking devices (cleats) press the panel tightly against the hull. All locks must be fully engaged; incomplete locking can lead to the door opening at sea and the ship taking in water.
Rampa/kapı çevresinde conta (rubber seal: Rubber seals around the ramp or door prevent seawater from entering; water collecting in the gaps is drained overboard through drains and non-return valves. A crushed or torn seal leaks. The second barrier (inner door) between the bow visor and the inner ramp gives additional protection.
Bow/stern door açık/kapalı ve kilitli du: The open/closed and locked status of the bow and stern doors must be shown continuously on the bridge (indication system); there may also be leak detection or TV monitoring for water ingress. The ship cannot proceed to sea until the door is fully closed and locked; this is ensured by procedure and by the indicators.
Rampa, ağır araç yükünü yapısal olarak t: The ramp must be strong enough to carry heavy vehicle loads structurally; axle load limits must not be exceeded. Vehicle traffic on the ramp is controlled and speed-limited.
Bakım; hidrolik sistem (sızıntı/basınç),: Maintenance covers the hydraulic system (leaks, pressure), locks and hinge pins, the condition of the seals, the indication sensors and the drain non-return valves. It is tested regularly that the indication system works correctly (that it does not give a false "closed").
Modern gemilerde döner hidrolik jib/knuc: On modern ships, slewing hydraulic jib or knuckle-boom cranes give fast cargo handling with a single operator. The classic derrick system carries the load between fixed points with two derricks in a union purchase arrangement; it is cheap, but slow and limited in its movements.
Kaldırma donanımı; tel halat, blok/makar: Lifting gear consists of wire ropes, blocks and sheaves, hooks, shackles, slings and swivels. Each item has its own SWL; the weakest item in the chain sets the limit for the whole system. The larger the sling angle, the higher the load in each leg.
Vinçte SWL sabit değildir; yarıçap arttı: A crane's SWL is not fixed; as the radius increases, the permitted load decreases so that the load moment (load × radius) stays constant. The operator must comply with the load chart; an overload is stopped by the overload cut-out.
Kaldırma donanımı proof load testinden g: Lifting gear undergoes a proof load test and is documented in the Register of Lifting Appliances and Cargo Handling Gear; examination by a competent person is required by ILO Convention 152. The certificates are checked by PSC and in inspections.
Kaldırma sırasında işaretçi (signalman/b: During lifting, a signalman (banksman), taglines, keeping clear of the area under the load and clear communication are essential. Snatch lifting, overloading and uncontrolled swinging are prohibited. Stability and list are checked during heavy lifts.
Bakım; tel halat tel kopması/aşınma kont: Maintenance covers checking wire ropes for broken wires and wear, the bearings of blocks and sheaves, the hook safety latch, the hydraulic system and testing the overload cut-out. The wire rope discard criteria (broken wires, reduction in diameter) are applied strictly.
Tank temizleme; deniz suyu (soğuk/sıcak): Tank cleaning is carried out by seawater washing (cold or hot), crude oil washing (COW) and chemical cleaning for stubborn residues. The method is chosen according to the remaining cargo, the next cargo (compatibility) and the gas-free target. Fixed or portable washing machines cover the whole surface.
Eductor, hareketli parçası olmayan bir j: An eductor is a jet pump with no moving parts: a high-speed driving flow (cargo or water) passing through a nozzle creates low pressure by the venturi effect and draws in the liquid at the tank bottom. It is ideal for stripping and draining and resists blockage and wear, but it depends on the driving flow rate.
Yıkama suyu ve kalıntı slop tankında top: Washing water and residues are collected in the slop tank, where they separate with the oil on top and water underneath (settling). In the load-on-top method, the separated water is discharged overboard within the permitted criteria, and the new cargo is loaded on top of the oily part; this reduces waste and pollution.
MARPOL Annex I, yağlı suyun denize deşar: MARPOL Annex I subjects the discharge of oily water into the sea to strict criteria (e.g. an instantaneous rate of discharge of oil not exceeding 30 litres per nautical mile, a total limit, distance from land, ship en route). The ODME (Oil Discharge Monitoring Equipment) measures the oil content continuously; if the criteria are exceeded, it stops the discharge automatically and keeps a record (Oil Record Book).
Tank içine giriş öncesi gas-freeing (hav: Before entering a tank, gas-freeing (ventilation) brings the hydrocarbon and toxic gas levels to a safe value and oxygen to about 21%; the enclosed space entry procedure, gas measurement and a permit are applied. Before air is introduced into an inerted tank, the tank is purged first, with the static electricity risk managed.
Bakım; eductor nozul/aşınma, yıkama maki: Maintenance covers the eductor nozzles and wear, the washing machines, ODME calibration and checking the level and interface measurement of the slop tank.
Demir ırgadının üç ana görevi vardır: de: The anchor windlass has three main tasks: letting go the anchor, heaving in the anchor and chain, and holding the ship at anchor. Each task loads a different subsystem of the windlass: when letting go, the band brake and free rotation are decisive; when heaving in, the drive motor and gearbox; and when holding, the chain stopper and the gypsy brake.
Modern gemilerde ırgat genellikle baş ka: On modern ships the windlass is usually on the forecastle, above the forepeak, with a separate gypsy (wildcat) for each anchor. In some designs the windlass and the forward mooring winches share a common drive unit (windlass-mooring winch combination).
IACS Unified Requirements (UR A1/A2), he: The IACS Unified Requirements (UR A1/A2) set the anchor mass and the chain diameter and length according to each ship's equipment number (EN). The windlass must be able to heave this chain at a given speed. A typical class requirement: the windlass must be able to heave in three shackles (about 82.5 m) of chain hanging in the water, together with the anchor, at an average speed of at least 9 m/min.
Gypsy (wildcat), zincirin baklalarına bi: The gypsy (wildcat) is a toothed drum profiled so that the links of the chain sit exactly in it. A separate gypsy is needed for each chain diameter; the links sitting fully in the pockets of the gypsy prevents the chain from slipping ("jumping") and being damaged. There is a clutch (dog clutch) between the gypsy and the main shaft; when letting go, the clutch is disengaged and the gypsy runs free.
Zincir, gypsy'den spurling pipe (zincir: From the gypsy the chain runs down the spurling pipe into the chain locker. The bitter end (the last end of the chain) is secured in the locker in a way that allows it to be released in an emergency.
Hidrolik ırgatlar, makine dairesi veya g: Hydraulic windlasses are supplied from a hydraulic power unit (HPU) in the engine room or below deck. A variable-displacement pump sends pressurised oil to the windlass motor; speed and torque are adjusted through pressure and flow. The hydraulic system gives natural protection against overload: as the load increases, the pressure rises and the relief valve opens and stops the windlass ("stall"), preventing mechanical damage.
Elektrikli ırgatlarda kademeli (pole-cha: Electric windlasses use pole-changing or frequency converter (VFD) controlled motors. Overload protection is provided by thermal relays and current limiting. Electric systems are easy to maintain, but the motor is strained by a sudden overload; a torque limiter or slip clutch may therefore be added.
Demir atmadan önce ırgat çalıştırılır, k: Before anchoring, the windlass is started, the clutch is engaged and the anchor is walked back under control to the water. When the bridge gives the order "Let go", the clutch is disengaged, the band brake is released and the anchor falls freely. The speed of the chain is controlled by the band brake; excessive speed damages the chain and the gypsy.
Vira sırasında ırgat zinciri toplar; köp: While heaving up, the windlass heaves in the chain; communication between the bridge and the forecastle about how the chain is leading and its weight (up and down) is critical. If the anchor starts to drag, the windlass must not be strained; engine assistance should be requested if necessary. When the anchor is aweigh, this is reported, and the anchor is washed down and heaved home into the hawse pipe.
Irgat bakımı; dişli kutusu yağ seviyesi/: Windlass maintenance covers the gearbox oil level and analysis, the thickness of the band brake lining, hydraulic pressure tests, greasing of the clutch and shaft bearings and checking the wear of the gypsy. A weekly running test and an annual detailed inspection are defined in the PMS (Planned Maintenance System).
Aşağıdaki tablo saha arızalarını ve müda: The table below summarises field faults and the remedies.
Klasik derik sistemi (union purchase/yum: The classic derrick system (union purchase) works by two derrick booms in fixed positions carrying the load with ropes; it is cheap but slow and limited. Modern ship cranes are slewing hydraulic jib or knuckle-boom cranes that give fast and precise cargo handling with a single operator.
Kaldırma donanımı; tel halat (wire rope): Lifting gear consists of wire ropes, blocks and sheaves, hooks, slings, shackles and swivels. Each item has its own SWL, and the weakest item in the chain sets the limit for the whole system.
SWL (Safe Working Load), vincin emniyetl: The SWL (Safe Working Load) is the maximum load the crane can lift safely. But the SWL is not fixed: as the radius increases, the overturning moment increases and the load that can be lifted decreases. The load moment (M = load × radius) cannot exceed the crane's design moment.
Ağır kaldırmada yük gemi merkezinden uza: In heavy lifting, as the load moves away from the ship's centreline a heeling moment arises; this affects both the ship's stability and the crane's radius. Ballast adjustment and list control are mandatory in heavy lift operations.
Vinç üç temel hareketi yapar: hoisting (: A crane makes three basic movements: hoisting (lifting and lowering), luffing (boom angle) and slewing (rotation). Each movement is driven by a hydraulic cylinder or motor and controlled proportionally with a joystick.
Modern vinçlerde yük momenti sınırlayıcı: Modern cranes have a load moment limiter (overload/moment limiter), speed limiting, hose burst valves and an emergency stop. When the load exceeds the SWL, the system stops automatically.
Kaldırma donanımı periyodik olarak proof: Lifting gear is tested periodically with a proof load (a test load above the SWL) and documented in the Register of Lifting Appliances and Cargo Handling Gear (cargo gear register). Examination by a competent person is required by ILO Convention 152.
Split drum vinçlerde tambur iki bölmelid: On split drum winches the drum has two sections: the working (tension) section and the storage section. Only one layer of rope carries tension in the working section; this prevents the brake holding capacity from falling with the rope diameter and the number of layers. On an undivided drum, the brake holding capacity decreases as the rope is wound in layers on top of each other.
Otomatik seviye vericiler: radar (mikrod: Automatic level transmitters are of the radar (microwave, non-contact, accurate), float (mechanical), capacitance and hydrostatic pressure types. The data goes to the display in the cargo control room and to the stability computer, and is cross-checked with the manual UTI.
Konteyner gemilerinde pontoon kapakları: On container ships, containers are stowed on the pontoon covers; the cover must be strong enough to carry the container stack load. Twistlocks and lashing gear secure the containers to the cover and to each other; the cover fittings must be undamaged.
Konteynerler köşe kutularından twistlock: Containers are locked to each other and to the ship at their corner castings with twistlocks; the lower tiers are tensioned to the lashing bridge or the deck with lashing rods and turnbuckles. As the stack height increases, the load on the upper containers and the risk of the stack tipping increase; heavy containers are therefore stowed at the bottom.
Ağır altta, hafif üstte istif ilkesi dev: The principle of heavy at the bottom and light on top reduces the overturning moment. Stack weight and tier limits must not be exceeded; a wrong weight declaration (VGM error) undermines the stowage plan and safety. The lashing plan is verified with software (lashing computer).
Band freni (brake band), gypsy'nin dış k: The band brake is a brake band that wraps around the outer rim of the gypsy and is tightened with a handwheel. It is the main static element that holds the ship at anchor. The clutch engages and disengages the gypsy and the drive shaft. The chain stopper (devil's claw / guillotine) locks the chain mechanically once anchoring is complete and takes the load off the windlass.
Otomatik gergili (auto-tension) vinçler: Auto-tension winches try to keep the line at a preset tension: they heave in if the tension falls and pay out (render) if it rises. However, with tide and draft changes, continuous rendering can compromise the ship's safety; many terminals therefore prohibit auto-tension while the ship is moored.
MBL (Minimum Breaking Load), halatın kop: The MBL (Minimum Breaking Load) is the load at which the line parts. The Ship Design MBL (SDMBL) is the reference MBL for which the mooring system is designed. The winch brake is set to slip (render) before the line parts, so that the brake gives way rather than the line.
Fren %60 MBL'de kaymaya ayarlanır ki aşı: The brake is set to slip at 60% of the MBL, so that under an overload it renders (slips in a controlled way) before the line parts. This protects both the line and the crew: the snap-back of a parting line is lethal.
Bağlamada çelik tel, yüksek modüllü sent: Steel wire, high-modulus synthetic (HMPE/Dyneema) and polyester/nylon ropes are used for mooring. Elongation and snap-back energy vary with the material; nylon is elastic but stores a lot of snap-back energy, while HMPE stretches little and is light.
Tipik bağlama düzeni baş/kıç hat (head/s: A typical mooring pattern consists of head and stern lines, breast lines and spring lines. The springs take the longitudinal forces and the breast lines the transverse forces. Lines of the same material and length are important for sharing the load evenly.
Bağlama, gemideki en tehlikeli operasyon: Mooring is one of the most dangerous operations on board. A drilled team, clear communication, keeping out of snap-back zones and wearing gloves and a hard hat are essential. While a line is under tension, no one should step over it or stand in a bight.
Vinç ve fren bakımı bağlama emniyetinin: Maintenance of the winches and brakes is the foundation of mooring safety.
Folding (katlanır) kapaklar, panelleri m: Folding covers have panels hinged to each other that fold like an accordion with hydraulic cylinders; they are common on container and general cargo ships. Side-rolling covers are preferred on bulk carriers; the panels roll sideways on wheels and open the hatch completely.
Kapaklar hidrolik silindir, zincir veya: The covers are moved by hydraulic cylinders, chains or wire ropes. Once closed, the cleats and quick-acting cleats press the panels down onto the coaming and compress the packing. The weathertightness of the cover depends on this pressing force.
Conta (rubber packing), panel çevresinde: The rubber packing sits in a channel around the panel and is compressed by the compression bar. Water collecting between the packing and the coaming is drained through a drain channel and a non-return valve. A blocked drain valve lets water leak into the hold.
Klasik weathertight testi, kapalı kapağa: The classic weathertightness test is to spray water at the closed cover at a given pressure and distance and see whether it leaks inside. However, it is difficult to apply with the hold full of cargo or in cold weather.
Ultrasonik (ses) sızdırmazlık testinde a: In the ultrasonic tightness test, a transmitter placed inside the hold emits sound and a receiver outside is moved along the line of the packing. If the sound leakage raises the measured level (% or dB) above a set threshold, there is a tightness defect at that point. It can be applied even with cargo on board.
Bakım; conta esnekliği/yırtık kontrolü,: Maintenance covers the elasticity of the packing and checks for tears, the straightness of the compression bars, cleaning of the drain valves, the operation of the cleats, the condition of the wheels and rails, and the hydraulic system. When the packing has taken a permanent set, tightness is lost and the packing must be renewed.
Capstan dikey eksende döner; halat tambu: A capstan turns about a vertical axis; the rope is wound a few turns around the barrel and held by friction (the capstan effect). The operator controls the friction by pulling on the slack end (tail) of the rope: pulling heaves it in, letting go lets it slip. This gives a controlled pull without winding the rope on permanently.
Warping, gemiyi rıhtım boyunca halatlarl: Warping is moving the ship along the quay with lines, done with a capstan or a winch warping head (warping drum/gypsy head). Mooring winches are usually fitted with a warping head; a capstan is found as a separate unit on small craft and special ships.
Bitt/bollard (baba), halatın volta edild: A set of bitts (bollard) is the double post on which the line is made fast in figure-of-eight turns; its SWL must be compatible with the MBL of the line. A fairlead is a roller or Panama chock that leads the line at the correct angle. A pedestal roller leads the line horizontally across the deck.
Halatın fairlead'den çıkış açısı (lead a: The sharper the angle at which the line leaves the fairlead (lead angle), the greater the friction and wear. In an ideal arrangement the line leaves the fairlead as straight as possible. A wrong angle both wears the line and causes uneven winding on the winch drum.
Sabit donanımın muayenesi; kaynak bölgel: Inspection of the fixed fittings covers checks for cracks, corrosion and deformation at the welds, greasing of the roller bearings and smoothing of sharpened surfaces. The SWL markings must be legible.
Balast suyu; yüksüz/kısmen yüklü gemide: Ballast water is taken on or discharged on a light or partly loaded ship for draft, trim, stability, hull strength (hull stress) and propeller immersion. But this water contains organisms from the port where it was taken on and carries them to where it is discharged. The BWM Convention aims to prevent this biological pollution.
D-1 (ballast water exchange) açık denizd: D-1 (ballast water exchange) requires the water to be exchanged in the open sea; D-2 (performance standard) requires the number of viable organisms in the discharged water to be brought below set limits. Once the transition period is over, all ships must meet D-2 (i.e. have an approved BWMS).
Yaygın bir yaklaşım: alımda filtrasyon (: A common approach: filtration on intake (holding back large organisms and sediment) + UV irradiation (preventing reproduction by damaging the DNA). It leaves no chemical residue and needs no neutralisation on discharge; however, UV efficiency falls in turbid water and the system needs a lot of power.
Alternatif: filtrasyon + elektroklorinas: Alternative: filtration + electrochlorination or chemicals (active substance produced in line). It gives strong treatment, but the residual (TRO — Total Residual Oxidant) must be neutralised and monitored before discharge. Efficiency varies in cold or low-salinity water.
BWMS, IMO BWMS Code'a göre tip onaylı ol: The BWMS must be type-approved under the IMO BWMS Code. The port state may take samples from the discharged water and check D-2 compliance. The operating parameters (flow rate, UV or TRO dose) must be kept within the approval limits.
Bakım; otomatik filtre geri yıkama (back: Maintenance covers automatic filter backflushing and element checks, UV lamp life and transparency or electrochlorination cell cleaning, TRO and sensor calibration, and monitoring of flow and pressure. A sensor failure can invalidate the compliance record.
OWS iki aşamayla çalışır: birinci kademe: The OWS works in two stages: in the first stage large oil droplets collect at the top by gravity (difference in density); in the second stage coalescer elements make small oil droplets grow and separate. The separated oil goes to the sludge or oil tank and the cleaned water to the 15 ppm monitor.
15 ppm bilge alarmı (oil content monitor: The 15 ppm bilge alarm (oil content monitor) measures the oil concentration in the outlet water continuously. If the value exceeds 15 ppm, the automatic three-way valve stops the water going overboard, diverts it back (to the bilge holding or slop tank) and gives an alarm. In this way water that exceeds the criterion never goes to sea.
MARPOL, makine dairesi sintine suyunun d: MARPOL allows machinery space bilge water to be discharged into the sea only under these conditions: the ship is en route, the oil content is 15 ppm or less, and the approved OWS and monitor are in operation. The rules are stricter in special areas.
\"Magic pipe\" — OWS'i by-pass ederek ya: The "magic pipe" — an illegal arrangement that bypasses the OWS and pumps oily water directly overboard — is one of the most heavily punished MARPOL violations. Authorities look for flange marks, extra hose connections, and discrepancies between the Oil Record Book and actual consumption and production.
Bakım; coalescer eleman temizlik/değişim: Maintenance covers cleaning or renewing the coalescer elements, cleaning and calibrating the glass/sensor of the 15 ppm monitor, function testing the three-way valve and checking the feed pump. Records of monitor tests and calibration are kept.
Black water tuvalet (lağım) atığıdır ve: Black water is toilet waste (sewage) and carries pathogens; grey water is waste from washbasins, showers and the galley. MARPOL Annex IV regulates black water; in some areas (e.g. the Baltic special area) stricter rules apply, including to grey water. The STP treats the waste biologically or chemically and disinfects it.
Yaygın yöntem biyolojik aktif çamur (aer: The common method is biological activated sludge (aerobic bacteria break down the organic matter) + settling + disinfection by chlorination or UV. Modern MBR (membrane bioreactor) systems give very clean effluent through membrane filtration. Electrochemical and chemical systems are also used.
Arıtılmış atık su, onaylı STP ile ve gem: Effluent from an approved STP can be discharged provided it meets the criteria. Comminuted and disinfected sewage is discharged more than 3 nautical miles from the nearest land, and untreated sewage more than 12 nautical miles from the nearest land, with the ship en route. Discharge is generally prohibited in port and in special areas; the sewage is held in tanks or delivered to a shore facility.
Biyolojik sistemlerde bakteri kültürünün: In biological systems the health of the bacterial culture is critical; too many chemicals (detergent, chlorine) kill the bacteria and the treatment collapses. Maintenance covers the aeration blowers, disinfectant dosing, the sludge level and (on MBR systems) cleaning and renewal of the membranes.
İnsineratör, brülörle ısıtılan yanma oda: The incinerator burns waste at high temperature (typically about 850–1200 °C) in a combustion chamber heated by a burner. Sludge oil is fed through a separate burner; solid waste (garbage) is loaded through the charging door. Sufficient temperature and air are essential for complete combustion and low emissions.
MARPOL bazı atıkların gemide yakılmasını: MARPOL prohibits the incineration of certain wastes on board, such as those containing PCBs, garbage containing heavy metals, halogenated plastics and cargo residues. General garbage (paper, food waste residues), sludge and waste oil may be incinerated. Incineration is recorded in the Garbage Record Book or the Oil Record Book.
Yükleme kapağı yanma sırasında açılmamal: The charging door must not be opened during combustion; there is a risk of blowback and flame. Ash is not removed until it has cooled sufficiently. The temperature and water content of the sludge service tank are checked; sludge with too much water disturbs combustion and can cause an explosion.
Bakım; brülör temizliği, refraktör (ateş: Maintenance covers cleaning the burner, checking the refractory (firebrick), removing ash and checking the uptake, the fan and the temperature sensors.
HVAC merkezinde bir soğutma çevrimi (chi: At the heart of the HVAC system is a refrigeration cycle (chiller or direct expansion); the compressor, condenser and evaporator remove heat with the refrigerant. The air handling unit (AHU) cools or heats the air, dehumidifies it and distributes it to the spaces through ducts. The return air is mixed with fresh air.
Hava soğutucu serpantinde yoğuşan nem al: Moisture condensing on the air cooling coil is removed (dehumidification); if necessary the air is reheated for comfort. Too much humidity causes mould and corrosion, too little causes discomfort. Humidity and temperature are controlled by thermostats and humidistats.
Yaşam mahalli genelde pozitif basınçta t: The accommodation is generally kept at positive pressure, so that air flows outwards through doors and openings and engine room smoke and smells and (on tankers) cargo vapour cannot get in. Sufficient fresh air changes prevent the build-up of CO₂ and smells.
Pompa dairesi, boya deposu ve akü odası: Hazardous spaces such as the pump room, paint store and battery room are swept continuously by mechanical (explosion-proof) ventilation to prevent the build-up of flammable gas. Fire dampers close the ducts in a fire, isolating flames and smoke and making the space tight for fire extinguishing.
HVAC nemli yüzeyleri ve su soğutmalı kul: Damp HVAC surfaces and water-cooled towers are environments where Legionella can grow; regular cleaning, disinfection and filter changes are essential for health. A dirty filter reduces both air quality and system efficiency.
Bakım; filtre temizlik/değişim, soğutucu: Maintenance covers cleaning or changing filters, refrigerant charge and leak checks, cleaning the drain pans, the fans and belts, damper movement and checking thermostats and sensors. Refrigerant gas leaks matter for the environment (F-gas) and for efficiency.
Hidrofor, içinde hava yastığı (air cushi: The hydrophore is a pressure tank with an air cushion inside; the pump pushes water into the tank, the air is compressed and creates pressure. When a tap is opened, the compressed air pushes the water out; when the pressure falls to the lower limit, the pump starts automatically (pressure switch). In this way pressure is maintained without the pump running continuously.
İçme suyu, ayrı (sadece içme suyuna ayrı: Drinking water is supplied from a separate fresh water tank reserved for drinking water only; the tank and pipes must have food-safe coatings and materials and must not be mixed with technical water. Non-return valves and the ban on cross-connections prevent contamination.
Sıcak su, calorifier'da (elektrik veya b: Hot water is heated in the calorifier (electrically or with steam or jacket water) and distributed through a circulation line. For Legionella control the hot water temperature is kept above a set level (generally storage at 60 °C or more); cold water is kept cool.
İçme suyu klorlama veya UV ile dezenfekt: Drinking water is disinfected by chlorination or UV; demineralised water from the FWG is mineralised if necessary. Tanks are cleaned and disinfected periodically and water samples are tested. Low chlorine or stagnant water invites bacterial growth.
Bakım; hidrofor hava yastığı kontrolü, p: Maintenance covers checking the hydrophore air cushion, setting the pressure switch, the pump and non-return valves, the calorifier anode and element, tank cleaning and disinfectant dosing. Water samples are tested regularly.
Soğutma çevrimi: kompresör soğutucu gazı: The refrigeration cycle: the compressor compresses the refrigerant gas (hot, high pressure), the condenser (seawater- or air-cooled) rejects the heat and liquefies the gas, the expansion valve lowers the pressure, and the evaporator (inside the store) draws heat from the store as the refrigerant evaporates at low pressure. Modern systems use environmentally friendly (low-GWP) refrigerants.
Bir kompresör ünitesi birkaç depoyu (et: One compressor unit serves several rooms (meat freezer about −18 °C, fish about −25 °C, vegetables and daily stores about +2 to +5 °C); the evaporator of each room is kept at its own temperature by a thermostatic expansion valve and a solenoid valve. The compressor load is adjusted to the low-temperature demand.
Evaporatör üzerinde biriken buz (frost): Ice (frost) building up on the evaporator reduces heat transfer; periodic defrosting (hot gas or electric) melts this ice. Too much humidity in the vegetable room causes rotting, too little causes drying out; ventilation and the balance of humidity preserve the quality of the food.
Gıda güvenliği için depo sıcaklıkları dü: For food safety, the store room temperatures are monitored and recorded regularly; if the cold chain is broken, provisions spoil. Cross-contamination is prevented (raw meat kept separate) and the rooms are kept clean. The MLC requires sufficient and properly stored food.
Bakım; soğutucu şarj ve kaçak kontrolü,: Maintenance covers refrigerant charge and leak checks, the compressor oil level, cleaning the condenser (seawater side), the defrost function, door seals and thermostats. Refrigerant gas leaks matter for the environment and for efficiency.
Starting air yüksek basınçtır (~30 bar): Starting air is at high pressure (about 30 bar) and is stored in the air receivers; control/instrument air is at a lower pressure (about 7 bar) but must be very clean and dry; working air is for general use (cleaning, pneumatic hand tools). Starting air is usually also fed to the control and service air systems through pressure reduction.
Sıkışan hava nem ve yağ içerir; after-co: Compressed air contains moisture and oil; the aftercooler and moisture separator remove the water, and for control air an air dryer (adsorption or refrigerated) also lowers the moisture. Wet or oily control air causes failures of valves and positioners, freezing and blocked instruments.
Marş havası şişeden basınç düşürücü (red: Starting air from the receiver is fed to the control and service lines through a reducing valve. Because a loss of control air can paralyse critical automation, continuity is ensured with a separate control air receiver (reserve).
En az iki kompresör ve iki hava şişesi y: At least two compressors and two air receivers provide redundancy; safety valves protect each pressure zone. The starting air line has a flame arrester and a bursting disc (against a starting air explosion). The air receivers are subject to class survey.
Bakım; kompresör supap/segman, intercool: Maintenance covers compressor valves and piston rings, the intercooler and aftercooler, dryer elements and regeneration, automatic drains, safety valve testing and internal inspection and draining of the air receivers. Insufficient draining leads to moisture build-up.
Kazandan çıkan buhar, dağıtım hattıyla t: Steam from the boiler goes through the distribution line to the consumers (HFO heater, tank heating coils, calorifier, fuel module). Having given up its heat, the steam condenses; the condensate returns through the condensate line to the cascade/hotwell tank and is pumped back into the boiler by the feed pump. The closed circuit minimises water losses.
Buhar tuzağı, oluşan kondensi ve havayı: A steam trap lets condensate and air pass but holds back steam, so that the heat stays in the consumer and the line is protected from water hammer. A faulty trap stuck open wastes steam (loss of energy); one stuck closed stops the heating.
HFO depolama/settling/service tankları v: HFO storage, settling and service tanks and the fuel heaters are heated with steam to lower the viscosity; on tankers, heavy cargoes (asphalt, crude oil) are made pumpable with heating coils. Overheating degrades the fuel or cargo; insufficient heating causes pumping problems.
Isıtma serpantininde delik olursa yakıt/: If a heating coil is holed, fuel or cargo leaks into the condensate and carries oil to the boiler (oil contamination); this causes foaming and carryover in the boiler and is dangerous. Oil traces are watched for in the condensate observation tank; contaminated condensate is not taken into the boiler but dumped.
Bakım; steam trap test/temizlik, kondens: Maintenance covers testing and cleaning the steam traps, watching for oil in the condensate observation tank, the feed pump and line tightness, the insulation and water chemistry. The condensate return (recovery) rate is monitored; a fall is a sign of a leak.
Fire main, makine dairesindeki yangın po: The fire main is supplied by the fire pumps in the engine room and distributed along the deck to the fire hydrants. There are isolating valves on the main; when a damaged section is isolated, the rest of the main stays pressurised. The main is kept under pressure continuously or ready to be pressurised quickly.
Uluslararası kıyı bağlantısı, gemi yangı: The international shore connection is a standard flange that allows the ship's fire main to receive water from the shore or from another ship. Its dimensions are an international standard; every ship carries one and its location is known. If the ship's pumps fail, it allows supply from shore or from another ship.
Yangın pompaları, en uzak/yüksek hydrant: The fire pumps must have the capacity to give sufficient pressure and jet range even at the farthest and highest hydrant. SOLAS requires two jets to operate simultaneously at a specified pressure (depending on the ship type). The pump capacity is related to the size of the ship and the capacity of the bilge and ballast pumps.
Ana makine dairesinde yangın çıkıp pompa: If a fire breaks out in the main engine room and the pumps are lost, the emergency fire pump, located outside the engine room (in a separate compartment) and driven by an independent power source (its own diesel or the emergency generator), comes into use. It must have its own sea suction and priming, and be able to work without passing through the engine room.
Her hydrant'ta hortum ve çift maksatlı (: Each hydrant has a hose and a dual-purpose (jet/spray) nozzle. Hoses are pressure-tested regularly; the jet, spray and shut-off functions of the nozzles are checked. The equipment must be easily accessible and marked.
CO₂ yanmayı, ortamdaki oksijeni yanmayı: CO₂ extinguishes a fire by reducing the oxygen in the space to a level that cannot sustain combustion (generally below about 15%); it also gives some cooling. It does not interrupt the flammable vapour chemically but only dilutes the oxygen, so the space must be closed (sealed).
Sistem; yüksek basınçlı CO₂ tüpleri bata: The system consists of a battery of high-pressure CO₂ cylinders (or a low-pressure bulk tank), a manifold, pilot cylinders, a master valve, distribution pipes and nozzles. Discharge is started from the release cabinet in the CO₂ room (with pilot CO₂); the pilot gas both opens the master valve and directs the gas to the space concerned.
Makine daireleri için CO₂ miktarı, korun: For machinery spaces, the quantity of CO₂ is calculated to fill a certain percentage of the protected volume (and the casing); for machinery spaces SOLAS requires CO₂ corresponding to about 40% of the gross volume (or a larger calculation including the casing). A different (lower) ratio is used for cargo spaces.
Makine daireleri için gazın büyük kısmı: For machinery spaces, most of the gas must be discharged in a short time (about 2 minutes) so that the concentration reaches the extinguishing level quickly and re-ignition is prevented. The pipe diameters and nozzle design provide this flow.
CO₂ insanı boğarak öldürür. Bu yüzden de: CO₂ kills people by suffocation. Therefore, before discharge: the space is evacuated; when the release cabinet is opened, an automatic audible and visual alarm sounds and the fans, fuel supply and ventilation stop (interlock); a time delay gives people time to get out, and only then is the gas released. Discharge does not take place until a head count (muster) has been made.
Deşarj için havalandırma fanları durmalı: For discharge, the ventilation fans must be stopped, the fuel valves closed and the dampers closed; otherwise the gas escapes and the concentration falls. After extinguishing, the space is ventilated thoroughly and the gas is measured before anyone re-enters.
Bakım; tüp tartımı/seviye (CO₂ kaybı tes: Maintenance covers weighing the cylinders or checking the level (to detect loss of CO₂), testing the pilot line and valves (without discharging gas), testing the alarm and time delay, checking nozzles and pipes for blockage and function testing the release cabinet. The cylinders are subject to periodic pressure tests.
Köpük, yanan sıvı üzerinde sürekli bir b: Foam forms a continuous blanket over the burning liquid: it cuts the fuel surface off from the air (oxygen isolation), suppresses the release of flammable vapour and cools with the water it contains. The covering must be continuous; if the foam blanket breaks down, the fire re-ignites.
AFFF (aqueous film-forming foam) yakıt ü: AFFF (aqueous film-forming foam) extinguishes quickly by forming a film of water on top of the fuel; protein and fluoroprotein foams give a durable blanket; alcohol-resistant (AR) foam forms a polymeric layer for polar solvents (alcohols, acetone). The foam must be chosen to suit the type of fuel.
Genleşme oranı (expansion ratio), köpük: The expansion ratio is the ratio of the volume of foam to the volume of the foam solution. Low expansion (up to 20:1) is used for long-range monitors and nozzles; medium expansion (20–200:1) for limited areas; high expansion (over 200:1) for filling a whole space (the engine room).
Köpük konsantresi su ile doğru oranda (t: The foam concentrate must be mixed with water in the correct proportion (typically 1%, 3% or 6%); mixing is done with an inductor (venturi), balanced pressure proportioner or bladder tank. A wrong proportion produces weak foam or none at all.
Tankerlerde güverte köpük sistemi; köpük: The deck foam system on tankers consists of a foam tank and proportioner, a main line, monitors (foam cannons) and hydrant applicators. A stock of foam sufficient to cover the whole cargo deck area at a specified rate for a specified time (e.g. at least 20 minutes) is mandatory.
Makine dairesi sıvı yakıt yangınları içi: For liquid fuel fires in the engine room there may be a fixed high-expansion foam system or a local application system; there are also portable foam applicators supplied from the fire main.
Bakım; köpük konsantresi periyodik anali: Maintenance covers periodic analysis of the foam concentrate (deterioration, sedimentation), testing the proportioner and monitors, blowing through the lines, and checking the tank level and the expiry date. If the concentrate ages, its extinguishing efficiency falls.
Sprinkler sistemi sürekli basınçlı su il: The sprinkler system is filled with water under continuous pressure (wet pipe). Each sprinkler head has a glass bulb that breaks with heat or a fusible link; only the heads in the area of the fire open and spray water, and the pressure drop triggers the pump and the alarm. In this way water is applied only where it is needed.
Sistem, basınçlı su tankı (pressure tank: The system provides the first water immediately from a pressure tank (with an air cushion); then the automatic sprinkler pump starts and keeps up the supply. The tank starts with fresh water; the pump draws seawater to keep the supply going. The sections are monitored separately.
Water mist, suyu yüksek basınçla çok inc: Water mist breaks water into very fine droplets (microns) under high pressure; the large surface area gives fast evaporation and strong cooling, and the steam produced dilutes the oxygen locally. It uses little water (little water damage), creates a non-conductive environment and can be a people-safe alternative to CO₂.
Makine dairesinde water mist hem total f: In the engine room, water mist is used both for total flooding and as local application for high-risk equipment (burners, separators, main engine); it quickly controls fires from oil leaks.
Sprinkler bölgeleri (sections) köprü/yan: The sprinkler sections are monitored separately on the bridge or fire control panel; which section has been triggered is seen immediately. Flow switches and pressure sensors help to locate the fire.
Bakım; pompa otomatik start testi, basın: Maintenance covers testing the automatic start of the pump, the air cushion and level of the pressure tank, testing the section valves and flow switches, visual checks of the heads (paint, damage) and checking water mist nozzles for blockage. The heads must not be painted or obstructed.
Yanma için yakıt, oksijen ve tutuşma kay: Combustion needs fuel, oxygen and a source of ignition. In a tanker's tank, hydrocarbon vapour and static electricity or sparks may be unavoidable; the IGS breaks the triangle by controlling the oxygen. When the tank atmosphere is kept at 8% O₂ or less, no explosion can occur whatever the vapour concentration.
IG iki şekilde üretilir: kazan baca gazı: Inert gas is produced in two ways: from boiler flue gas (which contains little O₂) or from an independent inert gas generator (by burning fuel). On product tankers a generator or nitrogen may be preferred for high purity. The gas produced is hot, contains sulphur and is laden with soot; it must be conditioned before use.
Scrubber (yıkayıcı), gazı deniz suyuyla: The scrubber washes the gas with seawater, removing most of the SOx and soot and cooling it. A demister/dryer then removes the moisture. Gas that has not been cleaned causes corrosion in the tanks and contaminates the cargo.
Kargo tankından gelen patlayıcı gazın ma: To prevent flammable gas from the cargo tanks escaping back to the generating side in the engine room, the deck water seal and a mechanical non-return valve work together. This double barrier prevents flame or vapour from flashing back; the water level in the deck seal is maintained continuously.
Basınç/vakum (P/V) valfleri tankı aşırı: Pressure/vacuum (P/V) valves protect the tank against overpressure and vacuum. The P/V breaker (liquid-filled safety device) gives the last protection for the main line. The low inert gas pressure alarm and the automatic blower stop protect the integrity of the system.
Boşaltma sırasında IG, inen sıvının yeri: During discharge, inert gas fills the space left by the falling liquid (the tank does not go into vacuum). During loading, the displaced gas is vented. Tank cleaning (COW/washing) is done in an inert atmosphere; the purging and gas-freeing procedures are controlled by O₂ and hydrocarbon measurements.
Bakım; O₂ analizör kalibrasyonu, scrubbe: Maintenance covers calibration of the O₂ analyser, cleaning of the scrubber and demister, testing the deck seal level and the non-return valve, and checking the blowers and P/V valves.
Duman dedektörleri (iyonizasyon/optik) e: Smoke detectors (ionisation/optical) detect particles at an early stage; heat detectors work on a fixed temperature or a rapid rise in temperature (rate-of-rise); flame detectors (UV/IR) see the radiation of an open flame. The most suitable detector is chosen for the type of space.
Mutfak gibi normalde duman/buhar olan ye: Heat detectors are used where there is normally smoke or steam, such as the galley; smoke detectors in cabins and corridors; and a combination of flame, smoke and heat detectors in the engine room. The wrong type causes either false alarms or late detection.
Konvansiyonel sistemde dedektörler bölge: In a conventional system the detectors are monitored by zone; the panel shows which zone has the fire. In an addressable system each detector has a unique address; the panel shows the exact detector and its status (fire, fault, contamination), which makes maintenance easier.
Kargo ambarlarında, her ambardan sürekli: In cargo holds, sample extraction smoke detection is used, drawing air samples continuously from each hold to detectors at a control station; the same system may be combined with the CO₂ extinguishing line. The pipes must not be blocked and must be correctly marked for each hold.
Yangın algılandığında panel sesli/görsel: When a fire is detected, the panel gives an audible and visual warning and shows the zone or detector. The general alarm that warns the crew can be operated separately or may be integrated. The bridge must be continuously manned and the alarms must be recorded.
Bakım; dedektör fonksiyon testi (test ga: Maintenance covers function testing of the detectors (test gas or heat source), cleaning off contamination, testing the manual call points, the panel batteries and back-up power, and checking the flow in the sample lines. Each detector tested is recorded, and the system is re-activated after maintenance.
Yangınlar yanan maddeye göre sınıflandır: Fires are classified by the material burning: A (solids: wood, paper), B (flammable liquids: fuel, oil), C (gases), D (combustible metals), F/K (cooking oil). The extinguisher must be chosen to suit the class of fire; a wrong choice can make the fire bigger or cause an electric shock or explosion.
Su (A için iyi, B/elektrikte tehlikeli),: Water (good for A, dangerous for B and electrical fires), foam (A/B), dry chemical powder (A/B/C, versatile but leaves residue), CO₂ (B and electrical, leaves no residue but is a risk in an enclosed space), wet chemical (class F cooking oil). For fires in electrical equipment, CO₂ or dry powder is preferred.
Söndürücüler; her mahalde yangın riskine: Extinguishers are placed in each space in the type and number suited to the fire risk, in visible and easily accessible positions close to the exits. There are separate requirements for the engine room, galley and accommodation areas. Their positions are marked on the fire control plan.
Kullanımda PASS yöntemi uygulanır: Pull: The PASS method is used: Pull (pull the pin), Aim (aim at the base of the flames), Squeeze (squeeze the handle), Sweep (sweep from side to side). The operator should keep the exit behind them, with the escape route kept clear.
EEBD, dumanlı/oksijensiz bir mahalden gü: An EEBD is an escape hood that supplies air or oxygen for a short time (typically 10 minutes or more) for escaping from a smoke-filled or oxygen-deficient space to a safe area. It is NOT used for fire-fighting or for entering a dangerous space; it is only for getting out. It is simple to use and quick to put on.
EEBD'ler; makine dairesi, yaşam mahalli: EEBDs are kept in sufficient numbers in visible, marked positions in the engine room, the accommodation and along escape routes. Their number and locations are shown on the fire control plan. In training every crew member practises putting one on.
SCBA; yüksek basınçlı hava tüpü (genelde: An SCBA consists of a high-pressure air cylinder (generally about 6–9 L, about 300 bar), a pressure reducer and demand valve, a full face mask, a back frame, and a pressure gauge with a low-pressure whistle. The mask is kept at positive pressure to prevent smoke getting in.
Tüpteki hava süresi, iş yüküne göre deği: The duration of the air in the cylinder depends on the workload; it runs out quickly with heavy effort. The team must keep a sufficient reserve for the return (generally at least as much as was used going in) and head for the exit before the low-pressure whistle sounds. Entry control and communication are mandatory.
Yangın müdahale takımı (fireman's outfit: The fire-fighter's outfit includes protective clothing, a helmet, gloves, boots, a lifeline, a torch, an axe and an SCBA. A specified number of complete outfits are kept on board in easily accessible, widely separated positions. Regular checks and training are essential.
Bakım; tüp basıncı kontrolü ve dolum, ma: Maintenance covers checking and refilling cylinder pressure, mask tightness and cleaning, function testing of the regulator, checking seals and straps, and following the EEBD expiry dates. A used SCBA cylinder is refilled at once; the equipment is always kept charged and ready.
Quick closing valve, yakıt/yağ tankların: A quick-closing valve is fitted at the outlet of fuel and oil tanks (settling, service, lubricating oil, HFO storage) and can be closed remotely with a single action. In a fire they are all tripped together from a point outside the engine room (usually a wire, pneumatic or hydraulic cabinet), cutting off the flow of fuel to the fire.
Quick closing valfler kapandıktan sonra: After the quick-closing valves have closed, they are reset one by one by hand (locally); accidental tripping stops the machinery. The trip points are therefore protected and marked. Regular testing verifies that the valves actually close.
Makine dairesi dışından uzaktan durdurul: Equipment that must be stoppable remotely from outside the engine room: fuel transfer and booster pumps, lubricating oil pumps, separators, ventilation fans and the boiler burner. This emergency stop arrangement isolates the space from fuel and air.
CO₂/köpük deşarjı öncesi havalandırma fa: Before a CO₂ or foam discharge, the ventilation fans must be stopped and the fire dampers closed; otherwise the extinguishing gas escapes and oxygen comes in from outside. The dampers can usually be closed remotely from outside the space.
Makine dairesi skylight'ları, kapıları v: The engine room skylights, doors and other openings must be able to be closed in a fire; there are remote closing or quick manual closing arrangements. The closing sequence and the people responsible are defined in the fire plan and the emergency procedure.
Tipik sıra: personel tahliyesi ve sayımı: Typical sequence: evacuation and head count → emergency stop (pumps, fans) → quick-closing valves → closing openings and dampers → verifying that the space is sealed → CO₂/foam discharge. This sequence is critical both for the safety of life and for extinguishing effectiveness.
Bakım; quick closing valf test (kapanma: Maintenance covers testing (verifying closure) and resetting the quick-closing valves, testing the emergency stop circuits, and checking damper movement and tightness.
GMDSS dokuz işlevi garanti eder; en krit: The GMDSS guarantees nine functions; the most critical are distress alerting (ship-to-shore, shore-to-ship, ship-to-ship), SAR coordination, on-scene communications, locating (SART), maritime safety information (MSI) and general communications. The aim is that no distress call goes unnoticed.
DSC (Digital Selective Calling), tehlike: DSC (Digital Selective Calling) sends a distress alert digitally (with the ship's identity (MMSI), position and nature of distress) at the touch of a button; coast stations and ships receive the alert automatically and give an alarm. This removes the need for a continuous aural watch, and the call is not missed.
GMDSS ekipmanı, geminin seyrettiği deniz: The GMDSS equipment is determined by the sea area in which the ship operates. A1: within range of a VHF coast station (about 20–30 miles). A2: within range of an MF coast station (about 100–150 miles). A3: within Inmarsat (GEO satellite) coverage (about 70°N to 70°S). A4: the polar regions (outside Inmarsat coverage; HF required).
