Yakıt ön ısıtmasını sabit 98 °C'ye değil: Set the fuel preheating not at a fixed 98 °C but according to the density and viscosity in the analysis and the separator maker's separation temperature nomogram; do not exceed the flash point and closed-system limits.
Debi ayarı kritiktir; yüksek debi ayrışm: Setting the throughput is critical; a high throughput reduces the separation quality. The maker's recommended throughput must not be exceeded.
Ana makine starting-air receiver sayısı,: The number, isolation and total capacity of the main engine starting air receivers are verified against SOLAS II-1 and the class/maker arrangement. The general capacity criterion is 12 consecutive starts without recharging by the compressors for reversible engines and 6 starts for non-reversible engines; it is not to be generalised as "6 starts per receiver".
Kompresör kademeleri arasında ara soğutm: Intercooling between the compressor stages and aftercooling are provided. There is an automatic drain (auto-drain) at the outlet of each stage.
Hava şişesi emniyet valfi, basınç şişeni: The air receiver safety valve opens when the pressure exceeds the receiver's design pressure.
Kontrol havası (instrument air): 5-7 bar: Control air (instrument air): dried and filtered air at 5–7 bar. It is used for pneumatic control valves and automation systems.
Servis havası (general service air): Güv: Service air (general service air): for deck work, tank cleaning and general use. It is reduced to 5–7 bar by a pressure regulator after the air dryer.
Ana motor jacket water ısısı (yaklaşık 8: The heat of the main engine jacket water (about 80 °C) evaporates seawater at low pressure (under vacuum). Because the evaporation temperature is lowered to 40–60 °C, no extra fuel is burned.
Plate tipi veya shell-tube tipi ısı eşan: A plate or shell-and-tube heat exchanger is used. The vapour is condensed with cooling water in the condenser to obtain fresh water.
Salinometre (tuzluluk ölçer) üretilen su: The salinometer checks the quality of the water produced continuously. If the salinity rises above 10 ppm, the water is automatically returned to the sea.
Yüksek basınç pompası (55-70 bar) deniz: A high-pressure pump (55–70 bar) forces seawater through a semi-permeable membrane. Salts and minerals stay on the other side of the membrane.
RO sistemi motor ısısına bağlı değildir;: The RO plant does not depend on engine heat, so it can also run when the main engine is stopped. The membrane life is 3–5 years; chemical cleaning (CIP) must be carried out regularly.
Enerji tüketimi evaporatöre göre daha yü: Its energy consumption is higher than that of an evaporator, but it has been reduced in modern systems with energy recovery.
Yanma odası refrakter tuğla ile kaplı, s: It has a combustion chamber lined with refractory brick, a sludge tank, a dosing pump, a burner and an air fan.
Sludge ön ısıtması/viskozitesi burner ve: Sludge preheating and viscosity are set to the atomisation range in the burner and dosing pump manuals; a fixed 90 °C is not safe for every sludge composition.
Katı atık (kağıt, gıda) charge door'dan: Solid waste (paper, food) is loaded through the charging door; after preheating, the flame burns it.
Baca: cyclone/scrubber + sıcaklık sensör: Uptake: cyclone/scrubber + temperature sensor + emission control.
1. kademe (gravity separator): yoğunluk: 1st stage (gravity separator): free oil and large droplets separate at the top through the difference in density.
2. kademe (coalescer / filter): emülsifi: 2nd stage (coalescer/filter): emulsified droplets are combined in the coalescing medium and separated.
15 ppm bilge alarm (OCM — Oil Content Mo: 15 ppm bilge alarm (OCM — Oil Content Monitor): approved under IMO MEPC.107(49); at 15 ppm or more it switches the three-way valve to the tank side.
Sludge ve yağ toplama tankı (slop/sludge: Sludge and oil collecting tank (slop/sludge tank) and overboard line.
Biyolojik (extended aeration): 3 hücreli: Biological (extended aeration): three chambers — aeration (digestion by micro-organisms) → settling → chlorination → discharge. The traditional and common type.
Elektrolitik: deniz suyu elektrolizle hi: Electrolytic: seawater produces hypochlorite by electrolysis; it disinfects chemically directly.
MBR (Membrane Bioreactor): biyolojik pro: MBR (Membrane Bioreactor): biological process + ultrafiltration membrane; the effluent is of very high quality.
Plakalı (plate): İnce oluklu paslanmaz/t: Plate type: thin corrugated stainless steel or titanium plates; high efficiency, small volume, easy cleaning. Common for the central cooler and the L.O. cooler.
Gövde-boru (shell & tube): Bir akışkan b: Shell and tube: one fluid passes through the tubes and the other through the shell. It withstands high pressure and temperature; it is used for F.O. heaters and steam heaters.
Charge air cooler (hava soğutucu): Turbo: Charge air cooler: cools the intake air compressed by the turbocharger; it increases the charge density (and the power).
Transfer edilen ısı, toplam ısı transfer: The heat transferred depends on the overall heat transfer coefficient (U), the area (A) and the logarithmic mean temperature difference (ΔTlm).
Kirlenme (fouling) U değerini düşürür; p: Fouling reduces the U value; a fall in performance is noticed by a rise in the outlet temperature.
Deniz suyu (SW) yalnızca merkezi (centra: Seawater (SW) goes only to the central cooler; the machinery is cooled by a low-salinity fresh water (LT/HT FW) circuit.
Yüksek sıcaklık (HT) devresi ceket suyun: The high-temperature (HT) circuit cools the jacket water and the low-temperature (LT) circuit cools the L.O., the charge air and the auxiliaries; a thermostatic valve keeps the temperature constant.
Avantaj: deniz suyu korozyonu sadece cen: Advantage: seawater corrosion is confined to the central cooler and the SW line; maintenance and service life are improved.
Et odası -18 °C, balık -25 °C, sebze +4: Typical temperatures: meat room −18 °C, fish −25 °C, vegetables +4 °C, dairy products +2 °C, dry provisions +10 °C.
Genellikle iki kompresör (duty/standby),: Usually two compressors (duty/standby), one condenser (water-cooled), and an expansion valve for each room.
Defrost: sıcak gaz veya elektrikli rezis: Defrost: periodic de-icing with hot gas or electric heating elements.
Solenoid valf, oda termostatına göre eva: The solenoid valve opens and closes the refrigerant flow to the evaporator according to the room thermostat.
Acil jeneratör, ana makine dairesi dışın: The emergency generator is in its own space outside the main machinery spaces, above the uppermost continuous deck and aft of the collision bulkhead. The aim is for the source to keep working even if the engine room is flooded or on fire.
Düzen kendi yakıt tankı, soğutma, yağlam: The arrangement must be independent of the main system, with its own fuel tank, cooling, lubrication and starting source. The flash point of the fuel and its fluidity in cold weather are assessed together with space heating and the block heater.
Marş düzeni akü, hidrolik akümülatör vey: The starting arrangement may be batteries, a hydraulic accumulator or an independent air receiver; in every case it is essential that it is not supplied from the main source of power and that it keeps its capability for consecutive starts.
Ana bara gerilimi kaybolduğunda düşük ge: When the main busbar voltage is lost, an undervoltage relay gives the generator a start command; when the set reaches its rated voltage and frequency, the emergency switchboard breaker closes. During this changeover, emergency lighting and communications are supplied from the transitional source of power.
Otomatik devreye girme süresi ve besleme: The automatic connection time and the supply duration are verified from the applicable SOLAS II-1 provisions for the ship type, tonnage and date of build; the requirements for cargo ships and passenger ships are not the same.
Beslenecek tüketici listesi gemiye özgüd: The list of consumers to be supplied is specific to the ship and is shown on the approved electrical diagrams: emergency lighting, navigation lights, GMDSS and internal communications, fire detection, the fire pump, watertight doors and, depending on the arrangement, the steering gear may be on this list.
Yalnız yüksüz çalıştırma gerçek koşullar: Running only without load does not represent real conditions. Long periods of running without load lead to unburnt fuel and soot accumulating on the exhaust side (wet stacking); periodic running under real load is recommended.
Denetimlerde en sık rastlanan bulgular;: The most common findings in inspections are the set not being returned to automatic mode after a test, a faulty battery charger, the space being used as a store and the fuel tank level being left low.
Düzen, makinenin serbest ucundan (front-: The arrangement uses a machine fitted at the free end of the engine (front-end PTO), on the gearbox or directly on the shaft. The same electrical machine can work both as a generator and as a motor.
Hibrit düzenlerde şaft makinesi batarya: In hybrid arrangements the shaft machine is combined with batteries or fuel cells and used for load levelling (peak shaving) and for reducing emissions during manoeuvring.
Şaft devri değiştiğinde üretilen frekans: When the shaft speed changes, the frequency generated changes too. Constant frequency is achieved in two ways: keeping the shaft speed constant with a controllable pitch propeller (CPP), or using a frequency converter to produce a constant output frequency at variable speed.
Konvertörlü düzenler, ana makine devrini: Arrangements with converters allow the main engine speed to be freed and therefore the fuel consumption to be optimised; on the other hand, harmonic filtering, cooling and converter redundancy are separate design items.
Manevra, liman ve düşük devirli seyirde: During manoeuvring, in port and at low engine speeds, the shaft generator output falls or it is disconnected; in these phases the load is transferred to the auxiliary diesel generators. A seamless changeover depends on the PMS (power management system) logic.
Ana makine trip ettiğinde şaft jeneratör: When the main engine trips, the shaft generator is lost too; the blackout risk is therefore assessed together with the automatic start time of the standby generator. Class and the flag state may set additional conditions for the shaft generator to be counted as a source of electrical power.
Tünel tipi itici, gövdedeki tünel içinde: A tunnel thruster works in a tunnel in the hull and produces only a transverse force. Retractable and azimuth thrusters produce a force that can be directed through 360°, giving dynamic positioning (DP) and manoeuvring capability.
Elektrik tahrikli düzenlerde motor gücü: In electrically driven arrangements the motor power loads the main switchboard directly; enough generator capacity is therefore brought on line before the thruster is used. The starting current and sudden load changes are the main sources of blackout risk.
İticinin ürettiği yanal kuvvet, gemi ile: The lateral force produced by the thruster falls quickly as the ship gains headway. The flow from the tunnel outlet interacts with the flow along the hull and cancels part of the force; thrusters are therefore typically effective only at very low speeds, and the manoeuvring plan is made with this limit in mind.
Tünel ızgarası (grid), deniz canlısı ve: The tunnel grid keeps out marine growth and foreign objects; if it fouls, it both reduces thrust and creates cavitation and vibration. During dry-docking the grid, the propeller blades and the tunnel coating are checked together.
Dişli kutusu ve hatve mekanizması yağla: The gearbox and pitch mechanism work in oil; the oil tank is located above the waterline, so that in a leak a fall in level is seen rather than seawater entering the oil. The level and pressure alarms are the first indication of a seal failure.
Su altındaki yağ dolu bölmelerden kaynak: Leaks from oil-filled compartments under water can cause a pollution incident. The use of environmentally acceptable lubricants (EAL) at lubrication points in contact with seawater is verified against the rules applicable in the ship's trading area.
Deniz suyu, yüksek ve alçak deniz sandık: Seawater is taken from the high and low sea chests. In shallow, muddy or icy waters, choosing the right sea chest determines the risk of blockage and of drawing in air.
Süzgeç (strainer) fark basıncı, tıkanman: The strainer differential pressure is the most reliable indicator of blockage. The sea chest steam/air blowing line is used in case of icing or blockage; an MGPS (anodes or electrolysis) may be fitted against marine growth.
Deniz suyu pompaları genellikle çift olu: There are usually two seawater pumps, one of them on standby; automatic changeover is triggered by a drop in pressure.
HT (yüksek sıcaklık) devresi ana makine: The HT (high-temperature) circuit circulates the main engine jacket water and typically works in the 80–90 °C range; the temperature is controlled by a three-way thermostatic valve. Running too cold leads to cold corrosion and fuel residue deposits on the liner surface.
LT (düşük sıcaklık) devresi yağ soğutucu: The LT (low-temperature) circuit serves the lubricating oil cooler, the charge air cooler, auxiliary machinery and compressors; the temperature at the central cooler inlet is usually held constant by an automatic valve.
Genleşme tankı, devrenin en yüksek nokta: The expansion tank is at the highest point of the circuit; it serves for venting, thermal expansion and topping up. A continuous fall in the tank level points to a leak, a continuous rise to an internal leak from a heat exchanger or a jacket.
Kapalı devre suyunun kimyasal şartlandır: Chemical treatment of the closed-circuit water prevents corrosion and cavitation erosion. The typical parameters measured are the nitrite/inhibitor level, pH and chloride content; the limits are taken from the ranges set by the chemical supplier and the engine maker.
Yüksek klorür, deniz suyu veya kötü kali: A high chloride level shows that seawater or poor-quality make-up water has got into the circuit. Topping up with distilled water and correct dosing directly affect the life of the heat exchangers and liners.
Zincir; depo tankı → çökeltme (settling): The chain runs: storage tank → settling tank → separator → service tank → supply pump → mixing tank → booster pump → final heater → viscometer → engine. Hot fuel returning from the engine goes back to the mixing tank.
Besleme pompası hat basıncını yükseltere: The supply pump raises the line pressure to prevent the fuel from vaporising when heated and causing a vapour lock (gassing); the booster pump provides the necessary circulation at the engine. This two-stage arrangement is needed for stable injection with heavy fuel.
Otomatik ters yıkamalı filtre ve fark ba: An automatic back-flushing filter and its differential pressure alarm are the first indication of an increase in solid contaminants. A rapid increase in the filter differential pressure usually signals a drop in separator performance.
Enjeksiyon kalitesini belirleyen büyüklü: The quantity that determines injection quality is viscosity, not temperature. The viscometer controls the final heater according to the value it measures; the target viscosity range is taken from the engine maker's instructions and kept the same from one fuel to another.
Viskozite çok yüksek kalırsa püskürtme k: If the viscosity stays too high, atomisation becomes coarse and late combustion and soot result; if it is too low, the pump elements lose lubrication and leakage increases. With distillate fuels a cooler may be needed to avoid going below the lower viscosity limit.
Yakıt değişimi (changeover) sırasında sı: During a fuel changeover the rate of temperature change is limited; a rapid change causes pump elements to seize and leak. The changeover is completed as planned before entering an emission control area and is recorded.
Servis tankı drenajı her vardiyada alını: The service tank is drained every watch; accumulated water and sediment are the most common cause of combustion problems. Tank heating is kept in a range that maintains the fluidity of the fuel without losing the light fractions through overheating.
Yakıt tanklarının seviyesi, sıcaklığı ve: The levels and temperatures of the fuel tanks and leaks in the heating steam lines are monitored regularly; water passing from a steam coil into a tank both spoils combustion and increases the load on the separators.
Karter veya ayrı yağ tankından alınan ya: Oil taken from the sump or a separate oil tank is pressurised by a pump, passes through the cooler and a full-flow filter and is distributed to the engine bearings. The return oil comes back to the tank and the cycle continues.
By-pass hattındaki separatör, sistemden: The separator on the bypass line continuously draws a small flow from the system and removes water and solids. This continuous cleaning directly determines the life of the oil and the safety of the bearings.
Düşük yağ basıncı, makinenin en kritik k: Low lubricating oil pressure is one of the most critical engine protections; the alarm and automatic shutdown chain is never disabled for operating convenience.
Silindir yağı gömlek yüzeyine ölçülü doz: Cylinder oil is fed to the liner surface in metered doses. The feed rate is set according to the engine load and the minimum set by the maker; too low a feed rate leads to wear and scuffing marks, too high a feed rate to deposits and unnecessary cost.
Yağın alkalinitesi (BN), yakıttaki kükür: The alkalinity of the oil (BN) is chosen to neutralise the acid formed from the sulphur in the fuel. Using a high-BN oil after changing over to low-sulphur fuel can cause calcium deposits and piston ring and liner problems.
Kazıma (scrape-down) yağ analizi, demir: Scrape-down oil analysis is the most practical feedback, through its iron content and residual alkalinity, on whether the feed rate is correct.
Yağ yağlamalı düzenlerde kıç şaft yatağı: In oil-lubricated arrangements the stern tube bearing is supplied from a header tank above the waterline. The height of the tank gives an internal pressure higher than the seawater pressure, making it harder for water to get in; the tank level is therefore a critical indicator.
Baş tank seviyesinin düşmesi denize yağ: A fall in the header tank level can mean oil leaking into the sea, and a rise can mean water entering the stern tube bearing. Both require the seals to be examined, and in the case of a leak the obligation to report pollution is assessed.
Deniz suyuyla temas eden yağlama noktala: The use of environmentally acceptable lubricants (EAL) at lubrication points in contact with seawater is verified against the rules applicable in the ship's trading area. In water-lubricated stern tube arrangements, the bearing material and the water flow are monitored.
Balast pompaları genellikle santrifüj ti: Ballast pumps are usually centrifugal and connected to the tanks through the main ballast line. The valves are mostly remotely operated by hydraulics or pneumatics; the indication on the mimic panel may not always match the actual valve position, so during critical operations it is verified locally.
Tank dibinde kalan suyun alınması için e: An eductor (ejector) is used to remove the water remaining at the bottom of a tank; it creates a vacuum with driving water and draws in the low-level water. If the driving pressure needed for the eductor is not provided, there is no suction and the tank cannot be stripped.
Balast operasyonu yükleme/tahliye planıy: Ballast operations are carried out in step with the loading/discharge plan; in the intermediate stages draft, trim and strength limits are monitored with the loading computer. The ballast water management requirements and records apply in addition.
Sintine kuyularında yüksek seviye alarmı: The bilge wells have high-level alarms; when the engine room is unmanned (UMS), this alarm is the basic early warning of flooding. If the well strainers and suction lines are blocked, the water cannot be pumped out even if the alarm comes.
Makine dairesinde, en yüksek kapasiteli: The engine room has an emergency bilge suction that takes suction directly through the largest-capacity pump. The valve position, accessibility and working condition of this arrangement are verified during drills; material stowed in front of it is a typical finding.
Sintine suyu, onaylı 15 ppm ekipmanından: Bilge water may not be discharged into the sea without passing through the approved 15 ppm equipment. The non-return valves and blank flanges that prevent cross-connection between the bilge and ballast lines are examined particularly closely in inspections.
Sintine suyunun aktarımı, denize verilme: The transfer of bilge water, its discharge into the sea or its delivery to a shore facility is entered in the Oil Record Book. Ballast operations come under the ballast water management plan and record book.
Kayıtların operasyonla ve tank sounding: In an inspection, the records being consistent with the operations and with the tank soundings is more decisive than the equipment simply being in working order.
Bir HPU; yağ tankı, değişken deplasmanlı: An HPU consists of an oil tank, a variable or fixed displacement pump, a relief valve, filters, a cooler, an accumulator and directional control valves. The lines to the consumers also have locking and load-holding valves.
Değişken deplasmanlı pompalar, talep olm: Variable displacement pumps reduce the flow when there is no demand, which reduces heating and energy consumption. In fixed displacement arrangements the excess flow returns through the relief valve and the oil temperature rises quickly.
Filtreler dönüş ve basınç hatlarında bul: Filters are fitted in the return and pressure lines; a differential pressure indicator signals contamination. If the filter bypass stays open, the system runs unfiltered and wear accelerates.
Akümülatör, azot gazı ile önceden şarj e: The accumulator stores energy through a chamber pre-charged with nitrogen gas. The pre-charge pressure is set to the value given by the maker; in general practice it is kept slightly below the minimum working pressure.
Ön şarj düşerse akümülatör kapasitesi az: If the pre-charge falls, the accumulator capacity decreases and the pump cuts in frequently; if it is too high, the oil volume cannot be used and the shock damping is lost. The pressure can only be read correctly after the system side has been depressurised.
Hidrolik arızalarının büyük bölümü kirli: Most hydraulic failures are caused by contamination. The target cleanliness class is set by the maker; the water content and particle count are followed periodically. If the tank breather filter is neglected, the system is open to moisture and dust.
Güvertede yüksek basınçlı yağ kaçağı cid: A high-pressure oil leak on deck is a serious injury risk; hands or bare skin are never used to look for a leak. Hoses are inspected regularly for age, cracks and kinks.
Denizle temas eden hidrolik düzenlerde (: For hydraulic arrangements in contact with the sea (steering gear, windlass, cranes, hatch covers), the use of environmentally acceptable oils and leak records are verified against the rules applicable in the ship's trading area.
Transfer pompaları genellikle vidalı vey: Transfer pumps are usually screw or gear-type positive displacement pumps; they give a stable flow with viscous fuel. There is a relief valve on the discharge side, because a positive displacement pump pumping against a closed valve can burst the line.
Tank ısıtma serpantinleri yakıtın pompal: Tank heating coils keep the fuel pumpable. A leaking coil both mixes water into the tank and carries oil into the condensate line, causing contamination; the condensate observation tank is therefore checked regularly.
Tank seviye göstergeleri, yüksek seviye: Tank level gauges, high-level alarms and the overflow tank are the most important layers of protection during a transfer. A transfer is not an operation to be left unattended while doing something else.
Sludge kaynakları; separatör boşaltmalar: Sources of sludge are separator discharges, filter cleaning, tank drains, fuel and oil leaks and the oil phase of the bilge tank. The quantity produced is directly related to the fuel quality used and the separator settings.
Bertaraf yolları sınırlıdır: onaylı insi: The disposal routes are limited: burning in an approved incinerator or delivery to a shore reception facility. The sludge tank having no direct connection overboard and the discharge line having the standard connection are among the first things checked in inspections.
Sludge tankı seviyesi, üretim ve bertara: Consistency between the sludge tank level and the quantities produced and disposed of (the mass balance) is critical for both operation and inspection. Records that do not match the actual levels are on their own a serious finding.
Bunker öncesi tank planı, kapasite hesab: Before bunkering, the tank plan, capacity calculation, communications and emergency stop method are agreed with the other party. The deck scuppers are plugged, the drip trays are emptied and the SOPEP equipment is kept ready.
Alım sırasında temsili numune alınır ve: A representative sample is taken and retained during delivery; the sample is the only objective evidence in disputes about fuel quality and sulphur compliance.
Operasyon boyunca sürekli gözetim, seviy: Continuous supervision, level monitoring and staged tank changes are applied throughout the operation. The moments of highest overflow risk are tank changes and the final topping-up.
Ana yangın pompaları makine dairesinde,: The main fire pumps are in the engine room; the emergency fire pump is in a separate compartment outside the engine room.
Yangın hattı (fire main) hidrantlar, ISC: The fire main supplies the hydrants, the ISC (international shore connection) and the fixed extinguishing systems.
Hat üzerinde basıncı koruyan jokey pompa: There may be a jockey (pressure maintenance) pump and a hydrophore tank that keep the main pressurised.
Yüksek basınç (HP) CO₂ silindirleri ~50: High-pressure (HP) CO₂ cylinders contain liquid CO₂ at about 50 bar; the most common type on ships.
Pilot silindir, master valfi ve manifold: The pilot cylinder provides the control gas that opens the master valve and the manifold valves.
Time delay (zaman geciktirici) personeli: The time delay gives a waiting time of 20–60 seconds for the evacuation of personnel.
Discharge nozülleri korunan hacme dağıtı: Discharge nozzles are distributed through the protected space; the CO₂ quantity, discharge time and distribution are approved according to the FSS Code design calculation and the net/gross volume definition of the space.
AFFF (Aqueous Film Forming Foam), hidrok: AFFF (Aqueous Film Forming Foam) forms a thin film on top of hydrocarbons; the common marine type.
Alcohol Resistant (AR-AFFF), polar çözüc: Alcohol-resistant foam (AR-AFFF) is used on polar solvent fires (alcohols, ketones).
High-expansion foam (genleşme oranı 200–: High-expansion foam (expansion ratio 200–1000) fills enclosed spaces quickly.
Sprinkler başlığındaki cam ampul belirli: The glass bulb in a sprinkler head bursts at a set temperature (generally 68 °C) and releases the water.
Hat basınçlı tutulur (wet pipe); su deşa: The line is kept pressurised (wet pipe); when water is discharged, the alarm valve operates.
Water mist, 70–200 bar basınçta 100 µm a: Water mist produces droplets below 100 µm at 70–200 bar; it extinguishes by displacing oxygen and by cooling through evaporation.
Flue gas scrubber, kazan baca gazını den: The flue gas scrubber cleans SO₂ and soot from the boiler flue gas by washing it with seawater.
Blower'lar gazı tank atmosferine basar;: The blowers deliver the gas to the tank atmosphere; typical pressure 800–1500 mmWC.
Deck water seal ve non-return valf, hidr: The deck water seal and the non-return valve prevent hydrocarbons from escaping back to the engine room.
P/V kırıcı (pressure/vacuum breaker) tan: The P/V breaker (pressure/vacuum breaker) is the last item of safety equipment protecting the tank pressure.
İyonizasyon ve fotoelektrik duman dedekt: Ionisation and photoelectric smoke detectors are used in cabins, corridors and control rooms.
Sıcaklık dedektörleri (sabit veya ROR –: Heat detectors (fixed temperature or ROR – rate of rise) are preferred in places with high humidity or steam, such as the galley and laundry.
Alev dedektörü (UV/IR) hidrokarbon yangı: Flame detectors (UV/IR) are used for hydrocarbon fires: helicopter deck, pump room.
Aspirating smoke detection (HSSD/VESDA): Aspirating smoke detection (HSSD/VESDA) gives highly sensitive early detection for cargo holds.
A sınıfı (katılar): su, AFFF köpük, çok: Class A (solids): water, AFFF foam, multi-purpose dry chemical.
B sınıfı (sıvılar): köpük, CO₂, kuru kim: Class B (liquids): foam, CO₂, dry chemical.
C sınıfı (gazlar): kuru kimyasal — önce: Class C (gases): dry chemical — the gas flow must be shut off first.
D sınıfı (metaller): özel D tozu (alümün: Class D (metals): special class D powder (for aluminium and magnesium fires).
Elektrik (eski E): CO₂ veya kuru kimyasa: Electrical (formerly E): CO₂ or dry chemical — water is never used.
EEBD minimum 10 dakikalık hava sağlar, s: An EEBD supplies air for a minimum of 10 minutes and is for escape only; it is not used for fire-fighting.
SCBA tipik 1200/1800/2000 L hava ile 30–: An SCBA typically gives a working time of 30–45 minutes with 1200/1800/2000 L of air.
SCBA seti: tüp, basınç regülatörü, deman: An SCBA set includes a cylinder, pressure regulator, demand valve, full face mask, back frame and low-pressure whistle.
Quick closing valves (QCV) makine daires: Quick-closing valves (QCV) are tripped from a panel outside the engine room; they close the valves on the fuel tanks, lubricating oil tanks and service tanks.
Fan stop ve damper kapatma sistemi makin: The fan stop and damper closing system cuts off the engine room ventilation and reduces the oxygen.
Yakıt pompası ve purifier emergency stop: The emergency stop buttons for the fuel pumps and purifiers are located outside the fire zone.
Skylight, jaluzi ve havalandırma kanalı: Skylights, louvres and ventilation duct closures can be closed manually or pneumatically.
Santrifüj kargo pompaları: ham petrol ve: Centrifugal cargo pumps: work at 1500–6000 m³/h on crude oil and product tankers; they are in the pump room and driven by steam or electric motors.
Submerged (deepwell) pompalar: kimyasal: Submerged (deepwell) pumps: hydraulically driven pumps fitted at the bottom of each tank on chemical tankers, one per tank; they eliminate the risk of cross-contamination.
Stripping pompaları: pozitif deplasmanlı: Stripping pumps: positive displacement type (screw or piston); used to draw the last ~5–20 m³ of cargo from the tank bottom.
Booster pompası: terminalin manifold bas: Booster pump: connected in series at the main pump outlet to raise the line pressure if the terminal manifold pressure is high.
Programlı dönen tank washing makineleri: Programmable rotating tank washing machines (Butterworth, Toftejorg) work at set angles and speeds at the top and bottom of the tank.
COW pompası ham petrolü 8–12 bar basınçl: The COW pump supplies crude oil to the machines at 8–12 bar.
IGS, COW boyunca tank atmosferini ≤%8 O₂: During COW the IGS keeps the tank atmosphere at 8% O₂ or less and at positive pressure; the inert gas delivered to the deck main must have 5% O₂ or less. The analyser reading is verified by proper sampling and calibration.
Fixed gas freeing fan ve hat purje düzen: Fixed gas-freeing fans and a line purging arrangement make the tank gas-free after washing.
Radar gauge: tank tepesinden mikrodalga: Radar gauge: measures the ullage with a microwave signal from the top of the tank; standard on crude oil and product tankers.
Float gauge: şamandıralı mekanik sistem;: Float gauge: a mechanical system with a float; easy to service but of low accuracy.
Pressure gauge (hidrostatik): tank dibi: Pressure gauge (hydrostatic): calculates the level by measuring the pressure at the tank bottom; common for ballast and double-bottom tanks.
Independent overfill alarm (IOA): yüksek: Independent overfill alarm (IOA): gives an alarm at high level independently of the main system.
Folding (katlanır) tip: hidrolik silindi: Folding type: the cover panels are opened with hydraulic cylinders and folded at the end of the hatch.
Side-rolling tip: panel raylar üzerinde: Side-rolling type: the panels roll sideways on rails; suitable for large hatches and common on bulk carriers.
Pontoon tip: tek parça paneller vinçle k: Pontoon type: single-piece panels lifted off by crane; standard on container ships.
Piggyback: iki panel arka arkaya kayar,: Piggyback: two panels slide one behind the other and stack on top of each other.
Twist-lock: container köşelerine geçen,: Twistlock: a lockable fitting that engages the corner castings of containers; there are semi-automatic and fully automatic variants.
Lashing rod: container köşesinden güvert: Lashing rod: a steel rod running from a container corner to a deck D-ring; it is tensioned with a turnbuckle.
Turnbuckle: lashing rod'un gerilimini ay: Turnbuckle: a threaded tensioning element that adjusts the tension of a lashing rod.
Stacking cone: container'ları üst üste h: Stacking cone: a passive fitting that aligns containers on top of each other.
Bridge fitting: yan yana iki container'ı: Bridge fitting: locks two adjacent containers together at their top corners.
Reefer plug socket: 32 A / 4 pin / 440 V: Reefer plug socket: 32 A / 4-pin / 440 V CEE form; for the power connection of each container.
Reefer monitoring system (RMS): set sıca: Reefer monitoring system (RMS): monitors the set temperature, return air, supply air and alarm status.
Power management system (PMS): toplam re: Power management system (PMS): balances the total reefer load against the generator capacity.
Container içi ünitede kompresör, kondens: The unit in the container contains a compressor, condenser, evaporator and fan.
Stern ramp: kıç tarafta açılan, en yaygı: Stern ramp: the most common loading ramp, opening at the stern; the quarter ramp variant opens out to one side at a set angle.
Side ramp: gemi yan tarafından açılır, t: Side ramp: opens from the ship's side; used depending on the terminal layout.
Bow visor + ramp: baş tarafta açılan kap: Bow visor + ramp: doors opening at the bow; the visor gives weathertight protection and the ramp is used for loading.
Internal ramp: güverteler arası araç har: Internal ramp: fixed or movable ramps for vehicle movement between decks.
Deck crane: 360° döner, hidrolik tahrikl: Deck crane: slews through 360°, hydraulically driven; 25–60 t SWL on bulk carriers and general cargo ships.
Derrick: tek veya çift halatlı sistem; b: Derrick: single or double rope system; simple, for light loads.
Stülcken derrick: iki direk arasında ağı: Stülcken derrick: can handle heavy loads (200+ t) between two posts.
Gantry crane: konteyner gemilerinde rays: Gantry crane: travels on rails on container ships.
Tank washing makineleri (portable Butter: Tank washing machines (portable Butterworth or fixed) wash with hot or cold water or chemical solutions.
Slop tankı, yıkama suyunu ve yağlı atığı: The slop tank holds the washing water and oily waste for a time so that they separate (decanting).
Eductor (jet pump): yıkama suyunu vakum: Eductor (jet pump): draws the washing water by vacuum and transfers it to the slop tank; it has no mechanical parts.
Heated washing line, viskoz ürünler için: A heated washing line supplies water at 60–80 °C for viscous products.
Filtre + UV (ultraviyole) sistemleri: 40: Filter + UV (ultraviolet) systems: a 40 µm disc or screen filter holds back large organisms; the UV reactor removes the ability to reproduce by damaging the DNA. No distinction between fresh and salt water is needed.
Filtre + Elektroklorinasyon (EC) sisteml: Filter + electrochlorination (EC) systems: produce active chlorine from seawater by electrolysis; disinfection takes place in the tank with chlorine. Neutralisation (sodium thiosulphate) is needed when deballasting.
Kimyasal dozajlı sistemler: peraset asit: Chemical dosing systems: work by dosing peracetic acid or chlorine dioxide; a reserve of chemicals is stocked.
Chiller: R134a/R407C/R513A soğutucu akış: Chiller: produces chilled water (7 °C) with R134a/R407C/R513A refrigerant.
AHU: chilled water coil + ısıtıcı (steam: AHU: contains a chilled water coil + heater (steam or electric) + humidifier + filter + fan.
Kanal sistemi: supply ve return; her mah: Duct system: supply and return; a grille/diffuser and damper in each space.
Reefer kompartmanı (provision room) ayrı: The provision rooms are kept between −20 °C and +5 °C with a separate expansion circuit.
Tatlı su tankı (FWT): soğuk su deposu; e: Fresh water tank (FWT): cold water storage; epoxy-coated or stainless steel.
Hidrofor pompası: santrifüj, tipik 4–6 b: Hydrophore pump: centrifugal, typically 4–6 bar discharge.
Basınç tankı (pressure vessel): membran: Pressure tank (pressure vessel): membrane type; 100–500 L volume, the air cushion reduces how often the pump starts and stops.
Presostat (pressure switch): genellikle: Pressure switch: generally starts at 3 bar and stops at 5 bar.
Kalorifer (calorifier): elektrik veya bu: Calorifier: an electrically or steam-heated hot water tank.
UV sterilizator ve mineral dozaj: içme s: UV steriliser and mineral dosing: for drinking water quality.
Ana hava kompresörü (main air compressor: Main air compressor: two-stage, 30 bar; charges the main air receiver.
Start-air receiver toplam kapasitesi, re: The total capacity of the starting air receivers is assessed against the criterion of at least 12 consecutive starts without recharging by the compressors for a reversible main engine, and at least 6 starts for a non-reversible arrangement, together with the approved piping and isolation arrangement.
Reducing valve: 30 bar → 7 bar control/w: Reducing valve: 30 bar → 7 bar for control and working air.
Air dryer: refrigerant veya desiccant ti: Air dryer: refrigerant or desiccant type; dew point −20 to −40 °C.
Acil kompresör (emergency air compressor: Emergency air compressor: a small compressor driven by a diesel engine or supplied from the emergency switchboard when power is lost; for the first start from dead ship.
Auxiliary boiler: yakıtlı (HFO/MGO) veya: Auxiliary boiler: oil-fired (HFO/MGO) or exhaust gas economiser; produces saturated steam at 7–10 bar.
Buhar kollektörü ve dağıtım hatları: izo: Steam manifold and distribution lines: insulated, with drain valves.
Steam trap (kondens kapanı): kondensi ay: Steam trap: separates the condensate and prevents steam from escaping.
Hot well tank: kondensi toplar, sıcaklığ: Hot well tank: collects the condensate and controls its temperature (for oxygen removal).
Feed water pompası: hot well'den kazana: Feed water pump: pumps water from the hot well into the boiler.
Deaerator: feed water'dan O₂ ve CO₂ uzak: Deaerator: removes O₂ and CO₂ from the feed water.
A1, bir Contracting Government tarafında: A1 is the area within continuous DSC alerting coverage of at least one VHF coast station, as defined by a Contracting Government; it is not a fixed 20–30 NM circle.
A2, A1 dışında en az bir MF coast statio: A2 is the area, excluding A1, within continuous DSC alerting coverage of at least one MF coast station; propagation range alone does not create sea area status.
A3, A1/A2 dışında gemideki tanınmış mobi: A3 is the area, excluding A1 and A2, within the continuous alerting coverage supported by the recognised mobile-satellite service of the ship's earth station; the modern GMDSS is not equated only with the Inmarsat geostationary area.
A4, A1/A2/A3 dışındaki alandır. HF DSC/r: A4 is the area outside A1, A2 and A3. The HF DSC/radiotelephony arrangement and the MSI route are verified against the current SOLAS Chapter IV and the Radio Record; NBDP is no longer assumed to be a general requirement.
Ch 16: tehlike, acil ve çağrı kanalı (15: Ch 16: distress, urgency and calling channel (156.800 MHz).
Ch 70: DSC tehlike kanalı (156.525 MHz): Ch 70: DSC distress channel (156.525 MHz) — voice use prohibited.
Ch 13: bridge-to-bridge gemi manevra hab: Ch 13: bridge-to-bridge communications for ship manoeuvring (156.650 MHz).
MF DSC: 2187.5 kHz; MF voice: 2182 kHz.
Distress alert: tek tuş ile gemi MMSI, p: Distress alert: sent to the RCC at the touch of a button with the ship's MMSI, position, nature of distress and UTC.
EGC SafetyNET: NAVAREA uyarısı, SAR mesa: EGC SafetyNET: NAVAREA warnings, SAR messages and weather reports, automatically.
EGC FleetNET: armatör veya ticari grup m: EGC FleetNET: messages from the owner or a commercial group.
Genel haberleşme: e-posta, teleks, SMS (: General communications: email, telex, SMS (through an LES — Land Earth Station).
406 MHz dijital beacon: gemi kimlik, poz: 406 MHz digital beacon: transmits the ship's identity, position and type of emergency.
121.5 MHz homing beacon: SAR helikopter/: 121.5 MHz homing beacon: for direction finding by SAR helicopters and ships.
GNSS'li beacon encoded position gönderir: A beacon with GNSS sends an encoded position; the actual accuracy and update rate depend on the beacon's type approval, the antenna's view of the sky and the GNSS fix status. Without GNSS, the independent Cospas-Sarsat location solution may be slower and less accurate.
HRU (Hydrostatic Release Unit): 1.5-4 m: HRU (Hydrostatic Release Unit): releases the bracket when it reaches a depth of 1.5–4 m; the EPIRB floats to the surface and is activated by water.
Radar SART, 9 GHz X-band sorgulamasını a: The radar SART detects interrogation by a 9 GHz X-band radar and produces sweeping responses across the band; 12 blips about 0.64 NM apart are seen on the radar screen, which may turn into arcs or circles at close range.
AIS-SART: AIS sinyali yayınlar, AIS rece: AIS-SART: transmits an AIS signal and appears as a MOB symbol on AIS receivers; shorter range, but it gives a digital position.
Lifeboat içinde özel bracket veya raftak: It is kept in a special bracket in the lifeboat or in the container in the liferaft.
Dormancy period 3–12 dakika arasında seç: The dormant period is set between 3 and 12 minutes; at the end of it a visual indication starts on the bridge.
Görsel indication 15 saniye içinde reset: If the visual indication is not reset within 15 seconds, the first-stage audible alarm starts on the bridge.
First-stage audible başladıktan 15 saniy: If there is still no reset 15 seconds after the first-stage audible alarm starts, the second-stage remote audible alarm starts at the location of the designated back-up officer and/or the Master.
Second-stage remote audible başladıktan: If there is no reset 90 seconds after the second-stage remote audible alarm starts, a third-stage alarm alerting other crew members able to take action comes into operation; on a cargo ship an approved combined arrangement may exist, and the total escalation time must not exceed the performance standard.
Bridge audio: conning station, radar/ECD: Bridge audio: coverage that distinguishes speech and audible alarms at the conning station, the radar/ECDIS and the communication workstations.
VHF communications: audio of the main radio.
Radar/ECDIS image: installation standard: Radar/ECDIS image: the display source(s) recorded according to the installation standard and the available interface.
GNSS, heading, speed, depth, AIS, rudder: GNSS, heading, speed, depth, AIS, rudder, engine/propulsion orders and responses, alarms and other required sources; the scope depends on the installation date and performance standard.
Capsule (Hardened/Float-free): yangın/su: Capsule (hardened/float-free): resistant to fire, water and depth; indicates its location with a pinger.
Totally Enclosed Lifeboat (TEL): tam kap: Totally enclosed lifeboat (TEL): fully covered, engine + air supply + sprinkler (fire-protected for tankers).
Free-fall lifeboat: tankers ve bulk için: Free-fall lifeboat: common on tankers and bulk carriers; drops into the water from an inclined ramp.
Partially Enclosed: yolcu gemilerinde, d: Partially enclosed: on passenger ships, for faster boarding.
Davit: Gravity (gravity-roller veya luff: Davit: gravity (gravity-roller or luffing arm) or free-fall ramp.
Sert plastik konteyner (canister) içinde: Packed in a hard plastic container (canister) or a valise: CO₂/N₂ cylinder, buoyancy tubes and canopy, painter line.
SOLAS A Pack, LSA Code'daki tam emergenc: The SOLAS A pack is the full set of emergency equipment in the LSA Code; the list of items and quantities is verified from the service certificate and the pack marking.
SOLAS B Pack yalnız Administration'ın iz: The SOLAS B pack is a reduced pack only for short international voyages permitted by the Administration; it is not chosen on an arbitrary "24-hour" limit.
Painter line: konteyner içindeki ipin uc: Painter line: the end of the line inside the container is attached to the ship; when the ship sinks it becomes taut and the raft inflates.
Rescue boat: rigid (RIB) veya inflatable: Rescue boat: rigid (RIB) or inflatable; with a capacity of 5 or more persons.
Fast Rescue Boat (FRB): ro-ro passenger: Fast rescue boat (FRB): at least one is required on ro-ro passenger ships; on other ships it depends on the approved arrangement. The speed and endurance criteria may differ with the full complement on board.
Davit: tek nokta veya çift nokta; hızlı: Davit: single-point or two-point; a single-fall davit is common for fast launching.
Donanım: outboard veya inboard motor, fe: Equipment: outboard or inboard engine, fender, painter, paddles, first aid kit, light and sea anchor.
